title: Technical Support Engineer I
description:
About us:
Build the future of banking.
Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.
About the Role:
As a Technical Support Engineer for Banking Technology, you are expected to have an overall relevant experience of at least 3+ years (with at least 1 year of relevant work experience in enterprise products in a B2B banking technology company).
Zeta Tachyon is an Enterprise Saas Platform comprising 100+ externally consumable APIs, 10+ Customer-facing interfaces and multiple Data Extracts with more and more functionality getting added every month in a fast-paced environment. As a Technical Support Engineer for Banking Technology, you will be responsible for providing technical support and expertise to address issues and ensure the smooth operation of banking systems and technologies.
You will play a crucial role in providing front-line technical support to customers and internal stakeholders at the client site. You will investigate issues hands-on, analyzing logs, tracing events, troubleshooting APIs and querying data before escalating, and will work closely with Zeta’s 24×7 offshore support team.
Responsibilities:
Customer Support & Issue Resolution
• Act as the primary technical contact for customer issues, delivering prompt, courteous, and professional support via email, phone, and ticketing systems.
• Monitor, triage, and prioritize incoming support requests based on urgency and business impact, ensuring timely resolution and high customer satisfaction.
Product Configuration & Maintenance
• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Zeta’s product suite to support seamless client onboarding and sustained operational performance.
Technical Operations & Protocol Handling
• Manage end-to-end payment transaction workflows.
• Execute SQL queries and work with APIs and card processing protocols, including ISO 8583, Visa, Mastercard, and RuPay.
• Troubleshoot banking systems, applications, and infrastructure issues using tools such as Postman, OpenSearch, Kibana, Splunk, and Grafana.
Log Analysis & Root Cause Investigation
• Analyze system logs to identify root causes and implement effective resolutions for recurring or critical issues.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with engineering, product, and QA teams to investigate and resolve complex technical challenges.
• Ensure timely escalation, clear communication, and effective knowledge sharing across teams.
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, including knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and implementation manuals.
• Document common issues, resolutions, and best practices to enable self-service and improve team efficiency.
Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
• Proactively evaluate and enhance operational workflows and support processes to drive efficiency and improve the customer experience.
24/7 Support Coverage
• Participate in on-call rotations to ensure continuous support availability, including support outside standard business hours when required.
Skills:
• Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and command-line troubleshooting.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues independently.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Customer-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality support and building trusted relationships.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly to evolving product and business requirements.
Experience & Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 3+ years of overall experience in technical support or product operations, with at least 1+ year supporting enterprise-level SaaS or banking technology products.
• Strong understanding of payment cards (credit, debit, prepaid) and payment transaction processing workflows.
• Proficiency in SQL (PostgreSQL preferred); ability to write and optimize queries.
• Solid understanding of APIs, with hands-on experience using Postman to test and troubleshoot API calls.
• Experience working with monitoring and log analysis tools such as Kibana (ELK stack), OpenSearch, Splunk, and Grafana.
Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Product Management - Senior Product Manager / PM-2 – Risk Product
description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services company and the pioneer of mobile QR payments. Our mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology.
About the role:
Paytm is expanding into merchant payments in Europe, and we're looking for a Product Manager to build its risk function from day one. You'll own the risk product strategy for our European merchant acquiring business: deciding which merchants we onboard, how we monitor them, and how we stop fraud and losses as volume grows. This is a 0→1 individual-contributor role with a lot of ownership. You'll lead through influence across engineering, operations, compliance, banking partners and leadership. We want an AI-first mindset: designing risk systems that use automation and predictive signals from the start, rather than adding them on later.
Key Responsibilities:
- Own the risk product vision and roadmap for the Europe merchant business ahead of launch, and through launch and scale.
- Design the merchant risk lifecycle end to end: onboarding and underwriting, KYB, ongoing monitoring, transaction risk, and chargeback and dispute management. Define risk policies, rules and limits for new markets. Calibrate risk appetite with business, finance and compliance stakeholders.
- Identify where AI/ML, automation and predictive signals can improve merchant screening, fraud detection and investigations. Turn those into PRDs and shipped features.
- Work with engineering and data teams to adapt Paytm's existing risk platform for European requirements and to build what's missing.
- Partner with compliance, legal, acquiring banks, card schemes and third-party vendors (KYB, sanctions screening, fraud tools) to meet regulatory and scheme obligations.
- Set up risk metrics and reporting, including fraud rates, chargeback ratios, loss rates and approval rates. Use data to drive decisions and experiments.
- Build a deep understanding of the European payments ecosystem (merchants, competitors, regulation, fraud patterns) and use it to shape strategy.
- Travel to Europe occasionally and work across time zones with local teams and partners.
What We're Looking For:
- 3–5 years of hands-on product management experience.
- B.Tech/B.E. from a premier institute, with strong technical depth.
- Experience in payments or fintech, ideally merchant acquiring, payment gateways or cards.
- An AI-first mindset, with a record of shipping ML/LLM-driven features or automation.
- Comfort owning ambiguous, 0→1 problems with little structure in place.
- Comfort with data and analytics for decision-making.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management, including with external partners and senior leadership.
- Nice to have: Familiarity with European payments regulation and scheme rules, such as PSD2/SCA, EU AML directives and Visa/Mastercard risk programmes.
- Nice to have: Experience in fraud, risk, merchant underwriting or compliance products.
Why join us:
Work with a high-performing and passionate product, design, and engineering team. Shape the future of credit for millions of users. Build at scale in one of India’s most dynamic and regulated spaces. Flexible and inclusive work environment with fast decision-making and ownership

title: Associate SDE
description:
About Hevo:
• Hevo is a Series B data infrastructure company with $42M raised.
• More than 2,000 companies across 40 plus countries use Hevo to move data from more than 150 sources into platforms such as Snowflake and BigQuery.
• Our customers include DoorDash, Shopify, Pinterest, Postman and Icelandair.
• Our engineering team is built in India, and so are the decisions.
• We are not the remote engineering office of a US company.
• The people building the product are the people deciding what to build.
What we are building:
• We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself.
• No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed.
• Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part.
• The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months?
• That is the job.
What you’ll own as Associate SDE at Hevo:
• Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction.
• Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing.
• Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship.
• Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks.
• Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality.
• Build internal tools with AI for business teams to run their functions
What you’ll bring to the table:
• Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles.
• Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics.
• Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) – no deep expertise needed.
• Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.
• Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges.
Candidate Persona:
• Freshers with experience in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools.
• B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college.
Why this role:
• Very few teams are building autonomous AI systems that operate production infrastructure where being wrong has real consequences.
• This is not a chatbot. It is infrastructure that has to remain correct, quietly, for months.
• If that kind of problem excites you, there are not many places working on it this early.
• You can talk to anyone in the company, including the CEO.
• What you are trusted with depends on what you can do, not your title.

title: Program Manager
description:
Who we are
Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.
Role summary
The Program Manager, Services runs the internal programs that make Mindtickle Services efficient, predictable and profitable. The role spans all four service lines — Professional Services, Content as a Service (CaaS), Managed Services and Technical Solutions — rather than a single customer engagement.
You will own portfolio-wide visibility into cost, revenue, margin and sourcing (in-house vs. outsourced); run strategic Services initiatives from charter to closure; coordinate internal response on escalations and accounts that need operational support; and build the executive narratives that leadership uses with founders, Sales and customers.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a structured operator who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a platform, a cross-functional working session and an executive deck.
Key responsibilities
1) Services portfolio governance & visibility
• Build and maintain a single source of truth across PS, CaaS, Managed Services and Technical Solutions: active programs, capacity, utilization, delivery health and risk.
• Run the Services governance cadence — weekly portfolio reviews, monthly business reviews and quarterly planning — with clear decision logs and action tracking.
• Define and standardize portfolio metrics and reporting so leadership can see issues early and act on data, not anecdotes.
2) Program financials: cost, revenue & sourcing
• Track Services revenue, cost and margin by service line, account and program; surface variance and its drivers.
• Maintain clear visibility into what is delivered in-house versus outsourced — vendor spend, contractor utilization and the cost/quality trade-off of each.
• Support pricing, estimation and capacity models with leadership, Finance and Presales; flag margin risk before deals are signed and during delivery.
• Prepare inputs for budgeting, forecasting and headcount planning.
3) Strategic initiatives
• Charter, plan and drive Services-wide initiatives end to end — e.g., AI-led delivery transformation, new service packaging, operating-model changes and tooling rollouts.
• Own initiative governance: scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, RAID logs and success metrics.
• Hold cross-functional owners accountable and report progress and outcomes to leadership.
4) Escalation & account operations support
• Act as the program lead on escalations: assemble the right internal team, run the recovery plan, track commitments and close the loop.
• Provide operational support to accounts that need it — resourcing gaps, cross-team dependencies, commercial or scope clarity — without becoming the day-to-day delivery owner.
• Capture root causes and turn recurring issues into process or product fixes.
5) Operational efficiency & process improvement
• Identify inefficiencies across service functions — hand-offs, duplicated effort, tooling gaps, manual reporting — and drive measurable fixes.
• Standardize playbooks, templates and operating rhythms across service lines.
• Partner with team leads to apply AI and automation to internal workflows (reporting, estimation, resource allocation).
6) Executive communication & storytelling
• Build executive presentations for founders, leadership reviews, Sales/GTM forums and customer executive meetings.
• Turn operational data into a clear narrative: what is happening, why it matters and what decision is needed.
• Draft briefs, business cases and updates for Services leadership.
Tools, cadences & metrics
Tools: Jira, Rocketlane, Excel/Google Sheets, Salesforce (inputs), BI dashboards, Google Slides/PowerPoint, and AI assistants for analysis and drafting.
Our Culture & Values
We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.
We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.
Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

title: Data Analyst
description:

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

About the role :-
At Fam, data plays a big role in how we build, improve and scale our products. We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys digging into data, asking the right questions and finding insights that others might miss. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Business and Finance teams, helping turn complex datasets into decisions that make a real impact. This is an opportunity to work on diverse problems, take ownership of your analysis, experiment with AI tools and help shape products used by millions of users. If you're curious, analytical and enjoy figuring things out, we'd love to have you on the team.
Must-haves
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics or another quantitative field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for identifying trends and patterns.
• Ability to interpret data and translate findings into meaningful business and product insights.
• Understanding of key product and business metrics.
• Comfortable using AI tools to improve analytical workflows, write and optimise queries, automate repetitive tasks and explore new ways of solving problems.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders.
• A proactive approach with the ability to take ownership of problems and drive them to closure.
Good-to-haves

• Familiarity with tools such as Metabase, Looker, Mixpanel or Amplitude.
• Working knowledge of Python and Excel.
• Exposure to A/B testing, cohort analysis and funnel analysis.
• Experience working with large-scale databases such as BigQuery, Redshift or ClickHouse.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Analyse user behaviour, funnels, cohorts and key business metrics.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business problems and provide analytical support.
• Leverage AI tools to streamline analysis, automate workflows and improve efficiency.
• Work on ad-hoc analysis and projects across different teams as business needs evolve.
Why Join Us
• Build a category-defining brand for the next generation in India.
• Work directly with founders and leadership in a high-visibility role with ownership from day one.
• Own partnerships that directly drive business growth and revenue.
• Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership culture where builders make an impact.
• Work in an AI-native environment with access to the best AI tools to move faster and build smarter.
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck

Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️
FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech
FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
Trusted by leading investors
We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

title: Assistant Manager - Regulatory Affairs
description:
Overview:
Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as a leader in this category. We are seeking talented individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. Candidates will be working with top healthcare providers in the country and leverage RPM's innovation to tackle healthcare's biggest challenges - from resource constraints to quality outcomes, to new care models.
As our Assistant Manager, Regulatory Affairs, you will be part of Dozee’s Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs team, leading regulatory impact assessments, labeling and claims review, and regulatory intelligence, keeping teams informed on current regulatory trends and changing US and international requirements. You will also support regulatory submissions, working in partnership with Product, Engineering, Quality and Marketing. It is a high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and who wants to help improve patient care through connected health.
Responsibilities
• Assess the regulatory impact of product, software and labeling changes for the US and international markets, including whether a change needs a new submission or can be documented as a letter to file.
• Review labeling, IFUs, marketing materials, website content and sales claims to confirm they are consistent with cleared indications and supported by evidence.
• Monitor current regulatory trends and changing US and international requirements (for example FDA software, AI/ML, cybersecurity and remote monitoring guidance), assess their impact on Dozee products and processes, and keep teams informed.
• Advise project teams from concept through launch on regulatory pathways, intended use and indications for use, and regulatory requirements.
• Support regulatory submissions and FDA interactions, including Pre-Submissions (Q-Subs), 510(k) inputs and responses to requests for additional information.
• Support international registrations and regulatory questions (for example India CDSCO and other markets), working with in-country partners as needed.
• Partner with Quality on regulatory commitments and post-market decisions, including FDA status updates, reportability and field action assessments.
• Maintain regulatory records, establishment registration and device listing, and regulatory trackers
Requirements
• 5+ years of regulatory affairs experience with US FDA-regulated medical devices.
• Master’s degree in science or a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Life Sciences.
• Hands-on experience with labeling, marketing and claims review against cleared indications.
• Regulatory impact assessments of design and labeling changes for the US and international markets, including use of FDA’s 510(k) change guidance.
• Working knowledge of 21 CFR 801, 803, 806 and 807, and international medical device regulations (for example India CDSCO, EU MDR).
• Strong regulatory writing skills and the ability to explain requirements clearly to engineering, product and marketing teams.
Nice to have
• FDA Pre-Submission / Q-Sub experience
• Class II 510(k) submission experience.
• Experience with software as a medical device (SaMD) or AI/algorithm-based devices.
• RAC certification.
Role Expectations
• Lead regulatory assessments and deliverables end-to-end and set the bar for regulatory compliance
• Translate team goals into clear plans and drive cross-functional collaboration.
• Share regulatory knowledge across teams through guidance and training.
• Use data to track progress and improve outcomes.
• Uphold Dozee’s values and quality-first culture in every deliverable.
Vision & Mission
Save Million lives with Health AI
Dozee is India’s leading AI-Powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS). A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A "Made in India for the World" solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs.
Dozee is adopted by 300+ hospitals and monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries. Dozee has monitored over 1 Mn Patients, Delivered 35000+ Life Saving Alerts and Saved 10 Mn+ Nursing Hours.

title: HR & Talent Partner

We're looking for an HR & Talent Partner to own tech hiring, employer branding and HR for our tech team, and to lead a small HR and admin team. You'll work closely with our engineering leaders and founders, and use AI and automation to keep hiring and HR fast.

• HR for the tech team: onboarding, performance cycles, engagement and employee queries
• Leading a small team: recruiter, HR associate and admin

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!
About the role:
Our customers use paid advertising to generate leads and grow their businesses. The Performance Marketing Specialist owns the execution and continuous improvement of these campaigns across Meta and Google.
You will work directly with customers to understand their business, translate their objectives into campaign strategies, take campaigns live and continuously improve performance.
This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You are expected to understand the numbers, make decisions, identify opportunities and execute experiments. The focus is on improving campaign outcomes, not simply managing campaigns or reporting performance.
What you'll do:
• Own customer campaigns end to end, from understanding requirements and setting up accounts to launching and managing campaigns.
• Understand each customer's business, industry, target audience and objectives to develop relevant campaign strategies.
• Manage and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads, including budgets, targeting, bidding, audiences and campaign structures.
• Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify opportunities and implement optimisations to improve metrics such as CPL, CPA, conversion rates and lead quality.
• Ideate and execute experiments across creatives, messaging, ad formats, audiences, targeting and campaign strategies.
• Explore different creative approaches and formats, including Reels, videos and variations in messaging, to improve campaign performance.
• Communicate directly with customers, understand their feedback, explain campaign performance and align on optimisation plans.
• Take ownership of campaign outcomes and proactively identify issues and opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.
What you have:
Must-haves
• Hands-on experience running and managing campaigns on both Meta Ads and Google Ads.
• Experience independently setting up, launching, monitoring and optimising campaigns.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate campaign data into actionable decisions.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in customer-facing situations.
• Strong account and stakeholder management skills.
• High ownership, bias towards execution and the ability to independently drive things to completion.
• Ability to understand different industries and customer behaviours and adapt campaign strategies accordingly. There is no single optimisation playbook that works for every business.
Good to have
• Minimum 2 years of genuine hands-on performance marketing experience.
• Experience running lead-generation campaigns.
• Experience with creative strategy and performance-driven ad experimentation.
• Prior experience in a digital marketing agency or managing multiple customer accounts.
• Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.
Why you'll love us:
• You'll be part of an early team at a fast-growing company, with a lot of impact
• You'll get to work with really smart and helpful people
• We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations
• Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture
• Flexible PTO policy
• Unlimited ai usage
• Plus cool swag, a stocked pantry, and other benefits

title: Account Executive | US SaaS Sales
description:

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
About Us
We are a global learning platform on a mission to motivate every learner by empowering every educator.
From K–12 classrooms and universities to corporate training settings, our platform is trusted in over 150+ countries by 75 million monthly active users. In the U.S., 90% of schools use Wayground to engage students and transform learning through technology.
Wayground is a high-growth, profitable SaaS company backed by leading investors including Tiger Global, GSV, and Nexus Venture Partners.
If you're excited about education and international SaaS and want to build towards a mission that you can be proud of, then Wayground is the right place for you.
About the Role
We're looking for a Customer Experience Specialist who is passionate about helping customers and delivering exceptional support experiences.
In this role, you'll be one of the primary points of contact for teachers, students, administrators, and other users who interact with Wayground. You'll own customer queries and concerns end-to-end, troubleshoot product-related issues, identify recurring problems, and ensure that every interaction leaves customers feeling heard and supported.
Beyond resolving tickets, you'll play an important role in understanding customer pain points, identifying opportunities to improve the product experience, and working closely with internal teams to make Wayground better.
We're looking for someone who combines strong communication skills, analytical thinking, empathy, and a genuine passion for solving problems.
What You'll Do
• Own Customer Interactions: Manage customer queries across multiple support channels, including email, chat, and other communication platforms, ensuring timely and effective resolutions.
• Troubleshoot & Resolve Issues: Investigate product-related queries, technical issues, and user concerns, guiding customers through solutions with clarity and patience.
• Drive Customer Satisfaction: Deliver a high-quality support experience by understanding customer needs, setting clear expectations, and ensuring issues are resolved to the customer's satisfaction.
• Manage Escalations: Take ownership of complex and sensitive customer issues, coordinating with relevant internal teams to drive resolutions within defined timelines.
• Identify Patterns & Insights: Analyse recurring customer queries, product issues, and feedback to identify trends and proactively highlight areas of improvement.
• Collaborate Cross-functionally: Work closely with Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to communicate customer feedback, report bugs, and improve the overall user experience.
• Maintain Support Excellence: Ensure accurate documentation of customer interactions, maintain knowledge base articles, and contribute to improving support workflows and processes.
• Track Performance Metrics: Monitor key support metrics such as response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction (CSAT), ticket backlog, and SLA adherence.
• Contribute to Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline support operations, improve self-service resources, and build scalable customer support processes.
Who You Are
• Have 2+ years of experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, Technical Support, or a similar customer-facing role.
• Have experience supporting customers for a SaaS, consumer technology, or ed-tech product.
• Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to grammar, clarity, and detail.
• Are comfortable troubleshooting product-related issues and breaking down technical concepts for non-technical users.
• Have strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently manage customer issues from start to resolution.
• Are empathetic, patient, and customer-obsessed, with the ability to handle challenging conversations professionally.
• Are comfortable working with support tools, ticketing systems, and CRM platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, or similar.
• Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining high standards of service quality.
• Are proactive, take ownership, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Good to have:
• Experience supporting international customers, particularly in the US market.
• Familiarity with customer support metrics, SLAs, and support operations.
• Experience working with AI-powered support tools and automation.
• Experience creating support documentation, FAQs, and knowledge base resources.
Working at Wayground
We're a small, passionate, tech-first team solving big challenges in education. We move fast, build with data, and obsess over creating delightful experiences for our global community of educators and learners.
The pandemic has changed work in many ways, especially by enabling remote work. Many companies have chosen to be remote first. At Wayground, we work best in the office brainstorming using whiteboards, having conversations over coffee/walks, or overhearing a hallway conversation. Learning happens through osmosis. We understand that driving/ubering takes work in Bangalore. We’ll take care of the commute for you.
Beyond taking care of commute, we will cover health care benefits for you, your family, and your parents. We invest in our employee’s health and wellness. Through books and courses, we invest in their learning and development. Oh, and finally, we have healthy lunches, dinners, and a stocked pantry to snack on all day.
Wayground is an equal opportunity employer and we believe diversity is key to our success.

title: Accountant / Senior Accountant - US Accounting
description:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!
Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs.

About the Role

This is an excellent opportunity for finance professionals to gain hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, operational accounting, revenue recognition, tax compliance, and financial reporting within a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP); familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) a plus.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines, especially during close cycles.
• Good communication skills and willingness to learn.
• Must be based in Bangalore and willing to work a night shift with hours overlapping US Pacific Time (through 12:00 PM PST), to coordinate with the US-based finance team.
What You'll Gain
• Hands-on exposure to end-to-end accounting operations, including global consolidation and investor reporting.
• Mentorship from experienced accounting professionals.
• Practical experience with month-end and quarter-end close processes.
• A strong foundation for a future career in corporate accounting or finance.
We care for our team

· ESOPs
· Medical and Life Insurance
· Paid Maternity & Parental Leave
· Corporate Uber Program
· Learning & Development Support
Acceldata for All
We are a fast-growing company, solving complex data problems at scale. We are driven by strong work ethics, high standards of excellence, and a spirit of collaboration. We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual.
Why Acceldata?
Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments.
Delivered as a SaaS product, Acceldata's solutions have been embraced by global customers, such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Zoominfo, GSK, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun & Bradstreet, and many more. Acceldata is a Series-C funded company and its investors include Insight Partners, March Capital, Lightspeed, Sorenson Ventures, Industry Ventures, and Emergent Ventures.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Drivetrain is on a mission to empower businesses to make better decisions. Our financial planning & decision-making platform helps companies scale and achieve their targets predictably.
Drivetrain is a remote-first company headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2021 by a couple of ex-Googlers, Drivetrain is a fast-growing company on a trajectory for success with backing from leading venture capital firms.
Drivetrain provides a great culture for its employees to thrive in and be happy.
💜 Remote-friendly: Drivetrain brings together the best and the brightest, no matter where they are and provides them a great degree of autonomy. We trust our people.
🗣️ Open & transparent: We know that when our creators have access to all the information they need, their best work will emerge.
👏 Idea-friendly: We provide an environment to explore new ideas, to take risks, to make mistakes, and to learn, so you can succeed. Anyone in the company can come up with great ideas and become a catalyst for positive change. We let the best ideas win.
👥 Customer-centric: We follow a product-led growth strategy, continuously learning from our customers and collaborating to build the amazing software that Drivetrain is.
The Role
You will own Drivetrain's security posture across our product, cloud infrastructure and internal systems. Working closely with Engineering, DevOps and Compliance, you will make sure security is built into how we ship, not added after the fact. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building systems, automating controls and using AI to scale a small security function well beyond its size. High-stakes work: you will protect the data that finance leaders at enterprise companies rely on.
What You'll Do
• Secure our cloud infrastructure (AWS), including IAM, network security, secrets management, logging and monitoring.
• Embed security into the SDLC through threat modeling, secure code reviews, and SAST, DAST and dependency scanning in CI/CD.
• Lead vulnerability management end to end, from discovery and triage to remediation with engineering teams.
• Own detection and incident response: build alerting, write runbooks, and lead investigations when something goes wrong.
• Drive compliance programs such as SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR, and automate evidence collection wherever possible.
• Answer customer security questionnaires and join security reviews with enterprise prospects alongside the sales team.
• Manage third-party and vendor risk, including reviews of the AI and data vendors we integrate with.
• Assess and secure the use of LLMs in our product, covering prompt injection, data leakage and model access controls.
• Run security awareness for the team and make secure practices the easy default.
What You Bring
• 4 to 7 years of hands-on experience in security engineering, cloud security or application security, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
• Strong working knowledge of AWS security services and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
• Experience securing web applications and APIs, with a solid grasp of the OWASP Top 10.
• Comfort writing code or scripts (Python, Go or similar) to automate security tasks.
• Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.
• AI fluency is a must, not a nice-to-have. You use AI tools every day to speed up your work, whether that is triaging alerts, reviewing code, drafting policies or automating compliance evidence, and you can show us how.
• Clear communication, so you can explain risk to engineers, leadership and enterprise customers alike.
Nice to Have
• Experience securing LLM-powered features or AI agent workflows.
• Exposure to fintech or other products that handle sensitive financial data.
• Hands-on experience with tools such as Vanta, Drata, Wiz, Snyk or similar.
• Certifications such as OSCP, AWS Security Specialty, CISSP or CCSP.
• Experience as the first or founding security hire at a startup.
Sounds exciting? Apply at careers@drivetrain.ai. It may just be the next best decision you’ve ever made!

title: Brand Reputation & Social Media Manager
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
Role at a glance
Mactores is an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and an Anthropic partner. Our delivery credentials are strong, but our public brand hasn't caught up. Our social channels don't reflect the work we deliver, we get little press coverage, and our client review presence is thin and poorly rated.
We're hiring one person to change that and own it end to end. You'll grow how Mactores is seen and talked about across social media, press, influencer and creator partnerships, and review platforms. You'll be building from near zero, but not from a blank page. There's a defined US market, a positioning source of truth and a working budget. You'll have the authority to plan and execute against them.
What you'll do
• Social media strategy and content. Running the Mactores presence on LinkedIn, X and YouTube, plus any new channel you can make a case for. You'll own the editorial calendar and write the social copy. You'll also brief designers and video editors, and publish consistently in formats that perform on each platform.
• Executive and employee advocacy. Building the personal brands of our leadership and delivery experts. That means ghostwriting in their voice, making it easy for them to post, and turning our engineers into credible voices in the conversations our buyers follow.
• Influencer and creator collaborations. Finding and vetting B2B tech creators, cloud and AI practitioners, podcast hosts and newsletter writers our buyers trust. You'll negotiate partnerships, brief them, manage delivery and measure the results.
• PR and media relations. Building relationships with journalists and editors covering enterprise tech, pitching stories, and landing coverage, interviews, podcast slots and bylines. You'll also write press releases for launches, partnerships and client wins.
• Community management and social listening. Responding to comments and mentions, tracking brand, competitor and industry conversations, and spotting openings for Mactores to join them.
• Reputation and reviews. Monitoring public sentiment and handling complaints or negative coverage calmly and quickly. You'll also run a disciplined client review programme on Google, Clutch and G2 with our delivery team.
• Awards and recognition. Finding the awards worth entering, and writing and submitting entries on time.
• Partner co-marketing. Running social and PR co-promotion with AWS and Anthropic alongside our alliance lead, including joint announcements, partner events and amplification.
• Events and live moments. Covering AWS re:Invent, industry conferences, webinars and Mactores events live on social, and turning them into content and press opportunities.
• Budget. Deciding where a modest annual budget goes across creators, sponsorships, boosted posts and awards, and defending each decision.
• The programme itself. Running a weekly cadence, keeping the tracker and Jira current, and flagging blockers early rather than quietly.
What we're looking for
This is the substance of the role. We are hiring for this list, not for a job title.
• Review programme operations. You know how star-rating math actually works, what review volume a B2B buyer needs before they trust a rating, and how to run a client review ask that converts. You know each platform’s rules cold, including what Google will and will not remove, why Clutch verifies by phone and why G2 rank cannot be bought, and you have never solicited a review in a way that breaks them.
• Directory and profile management at scale. You can build and maintain dozens of third-party profiles without drift, and you understand how directory ranking algorithms weight reviews, completeness and paid tiers.
• Award and analyst submission writing. You can write to a judging rubric using evidence, outcomes and numbers rather than adjectives, and complete an analyst questionnaire or vendor briefing without overclaiming.
• Pitch writing and media relationships. You can write an email a busy editor replies to, build relationships with journalists covering enterprise tech, and land guest placements on high-authority publications.
• Judgement on paid versus earned. You can tell the difference between a judged credential and a pay-to-play listicle, you understand FTC native-advertising labelling, and you can argue for spending money on the first and not the second.
• Local SEO and Google Business Profile. Claiming, verification including video verification, multi-location eligibility rules, review handling across locations, and recovering a suspended profile.
• Entity and knowledge graph literacy. Wikidata, Wikipedia notability standards, and how structured entity data feeds Google’s Knowledge Panel and AI answer engines.
• SEO fundamentals. Domain authority, referring domains, do-follow versus no-follow, anchor text strategy, and why a link is worth having.
• Messaging discipline. You will work from a single positioning source of truth and keep thirty profiles saying the same thing. Consistency here matters more than creativity.
• Programme and budget management. Running a multi-workstream calendar against fixed external deadlines, tracking spend against allocation, and coordinating people who do not report to you across delivery, alliances, finance and legal.
• Enterprise tech literacy. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to hold a credible conversation about cloud, data and AI with a technology editor or an industry analyst.
• Self-direction. Parallel threads, hard external deadlines, no supervision.
You'll be preferred if you
• Experience marketing an AWS, Azure or GCP partner, or a B2B services firm selling into US enterprises.
• Existing relationships with enterprise tech journalists, podcast hosts or B2B creators.
• A track record of building a founder or executive personal brand on LinkedIn.
• Basic design and short-form video skills (Canva, Figma, CapCut or equivalents).
• Hands-on experience with Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Brand24, Muck Rack, Cision, Taplio or equivalents.
• Comfort with Jira, or a clear willingness to learn it quickly.
How Success Is Measured
• Social growth among the right audience: engagement rate, reach, share of voice against named competitors, and inbound conversations started from social.
• Executive advocacy: how many leaders post consistently, and the reach and engagement they earn.
• Influencer and creator campaigns delivered, and the reach, engagement and pipeline influence they generate.
• Earned media: coverage, interviews, podcast slots and bylines landed, and the quality of the outlets.
• Brand sentiment, response time on public mentions, and client review count and rating against staged targets.
• Awards earned.
• Budget discipline: what was bought, what was skipped, and whether the reasoning held up.
• Programme hygiene: tracker current, deadlines never missed silently, blockers raised early.
Life at Mactores
We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
1. Be one step ahead
2. Deliver the best
3. Be bold
4. Pay attention to the detail
5. Enjoy the challenge
6. Be curious and take action
7. Take leadership
8. Own it
9. Deliver value
10. Be collaborative

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
⚡️ About Merkle Science
Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.
Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over US$27 MM from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others.
The Role
You will design, build and run the systems behind our data products, covering ingestion, processing, analytical storage and serving. You own your work from the design document through to production. The people who design a pipeline also run it and answer for its numbers.
Our stack is very wide, and we go deep in every part of it. We don't stop at "it works." We keep measuring, profiling and tuning to make systems faster, cheaper and more reliable. We want engineers who are razor sharp, pay close attention to detail, and care as much about why a query takes 800 ms as whether it returns the right answer.
You don't need blockchain experience. If you're a strong data engineer who wants to learn it, we'd like to hear from you.
What You'll Do
• Design and build scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and platform systems for blockchain data across 30+ chains.
• Build backend data services and loaders in Go and Python.
• Design and evolve data models and analytical workloads in ClickHouse, and tune them for sub-second queries.
• Build incremental, idempotent pipelines on Databricks over billions of rows and tens of terabytes.
• Keep improving the scale, reliability, freshness, performance and cost efficiency of the platform.
• Investigate hard performance and reliability problems and see them through to resolution.
• Work closely with the product, analytics and investigations teams that use the data, and turn their needs into platform designs.
• Help set technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews and code reviews.
• Mentor engineers and help set strong engineering and operational practices.
What You Bring
• 5+ years building and operating production data systems, including ETL and ELT pipelines. At least two of those years should be spent owning systems that other engineers depend on.
• Expert Python and strong SQL. You write typed, tested code, are comfortable with asyncio and concurrency, and have built incremental data models over billions of rows.
• Go for backend services. You have built and run high-throughput services or data loaders in Go in production.
• ClickHouse in production. You know MergeTree schema and sort-key design, materialised views, bulk loads and query tuning.
• Databricks in production. You have worked with PySpark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, designed incremental and idempotent tables, and kept an eye on compute cost.
• Large-scale data. You have hands-on experience with pipelines over billions of rows and tens of terabytes. You understand how partitioning, clustering and file sizing affect cost and latency.
• Kafka, Airflow and Kubernetes in production. You understand delivery semantics and idempotent writes, have handled backfills and failures, and have run data workloads with Docker and Helm. Google Cloud is preferred; AWS is fine.
• An operations and communication mindset. You instrument what you build, write runbooks and post-incident reviews, and can write a design document that a reviewer in another time zone can approve.
Nice to Have
• Blockchain data: EVM, UTXO or non-EVM chain data models, and pulling data from nodes over JSON-RPC or gRPC.
• Graph or distributed key-value stores: entity resolution or clustering on large graphs.
• Infrastructure as code, GitOps and observability: Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, and load-test design.
• Experience building platforms that serve multiple data sources, datasets or product teams.
• AI-assisted development, and experience in fintech, compliance or AML.
How We Work
• You'll join a small, senior team where everyone owns their work end to end.
• We make decisions based on measured evidence, not opinion.
• We keep design notes and runbooks next to the code.
• We test at production scale and run blameless post-incident reviews.
• We use AI coding tools every day, and we use judgement when reviewing what they produce.
❤️ Well Being, Compensation and Benefits
We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.
We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

title: Senior Technical PM, Applied AI
description:
About the Company:
Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences.
Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!
Netomi is hiring a Senior Technical PM to own the product strategy and roadmap for our Agents platform. You will decide what we build and why, tie every investment to enterprise customer and business outcomes, and get capabilities shipped and adopted by some of the world’s largest brands.
This role is also firmly hands-on. You will work directly with AI labs, understand new model capabilities early, build experiments and prototypes yourself, design evaluations and debug failing agents. You use that hands-on work to make better, faster product decisions.
Product and business ownership
• Business focus: tie the roadmap to measurable business outcomes such as autonomous resolution rate, cost per resolution, CSAT, revenue expansion and competitive wins. Know where Netomi wins and loses against competitors, and shape our position.
• Product strategy and roadmap: own the multi-quarter roadmap for Agents end to end, from problem discovery and prioritization to delivery and outcome tracking. Make and defend hard trade-offs when priorities compete.
• Customer and partner needs: work directly with enterprise customers, Customer Success, Delivery and Sales to find the highest-value problems. Translate them into clear problem statements, PRDs, user stories, success metrics and dependency maps.
• Cross-functional leadership: drive alignment across engineering, research, data science, QA and go-to-market on scope, dependencies and launch readiness, without direct authority.
• Planning and execution: run the cadence of quarterly roadmap inputs, monthly scope lock, weekly execution reviews and launch readiness sign-offs.
• Launch and adoption: own launch checklists (instrumentation, enablement, success criteria), track adoption per capability and publish a monthly Agent Outcomes readout across deployments.
• Post-release learning: run monitoring windows and post-incident reviews, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.
Product areas you will own
• Agent reasoning and orchestration: multi-step task planning, action selection, retry and fallback logic, and supervisor and sub-agent patterns.
• Tool and API use: reliable, observable, policy-compliant tool calling for CRM, ITSM and custom enterprise systems, including MCP.
• Memory and context: conversation memory, long-running task state and continuity across channels and sessions.
• Human-in-the-loop: clarification, graceful escalation to live agents, approval steps for high-risk actions and hybrid autonomy modes.
• Enterprise governance: guardrails, audit trails, explainable decisions, role-based access, and safe rollout through shadow mode, staged releases and rollback.
Hands-on work
• AI labs and new capabilities: be our product point person with AI labs and model providers. Test new models and features (reasoning, tool use, realtime voice, memory) on our use cases, decide what to build, change or skip, and give labs evidence-based feedback.
• Experiments and prototypes: vibe code prototypes, build agents, and connect them to real systems through APIs and MCP tools. Run offline tests, shadow mode and canary releases with clear decision criteria, and hand engineering a working reference, not just a document.
• Evaluation and quality: define the Agent Readiness Scorecard and Go/No-Go criteria. Design evals for task completion, tool success, policy compliance, latency and cost, and keep regression tests running on every model, prompt or tool change.
• Debugging production failures: read agent traces with engineering, find root causes (wrong action, missed escalation, bad tool call, memory gaps) and make sure each serious failure gets a fix and a test.
• Model choices: inform model selection and routing decisions by weighing quality, latency and cost with real data.
Requirements
Product skills
• Roughly 4–8 years of relevant experience, ideally from a deeply technical product role, applied AI engineering or research engineering with clear product ownership.
• Proven ownership of a complex technical product area, with features delivered to enterprise customers and measurable business results.
• Strong product judgment: you can prioritize, work with customers and get capabilities shipped.
• Customer-first: you turn enterprise needs into clear, actionable requirements.
• Excellent communicator who can align engineering, research and go-to-market teams and present clearly to executives.
Hands-on skills
• Comfortable vibe coding, building agents, connecting APIs and MCP tools, designing evaluations and debugging production failures.
• Deep understanding of LLM reasoning, tool calling, multi-step task execution, orchestration patterns, evaluation methods and production observability for agents.
• Technical fluency with APIs, cloud environments and AI deployment workflows.
Nice to have
• Experience shipping AI agent products at a conversational AI or enterprise AI platform company.
• Direct experience working with AI labs or model providers (early-access programs, model evaluations).
• Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., LangGraph, MCP) and with voice AI.
• Experience in regulated or mission-critical industries (airlines, banking, healthcare, payments) and with large SI partners.
• Public work you can show: a repo, demo, blog post or talk.
Netomi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - India
description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.
About the Role
We're hiring a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer to join the Cloud Platform organization, which owns JumpCloud's cloud infrastructure, developer experience, and edge and traffic engineering.
This is a hands-on principal role. You'll write production code and you'll run what you build. You'll set the technical direction for the platform that keeps JumpCloud available at 99.99% across regions, and you'll raise the engineering bar for everyone around you. We want someone who is as comfortable designing and shipping a platform service as they are leading a major incident at 2 a.m.
What You'll Be Doing :
• Set the technical direction and multi-year architecture for JumpCloud's cloud platform across AWS and GCP, covering compute, networking, Kubernetes, data stores, and edge.
• Write production-grade Go or Python as a regular part of the job: platform services, Kubernetes controllers and operators, internal APIs, CLIs, and automation that removes manual work.
• Build and evolve our internal developer platform, including golden paths, self-service provisioning, and CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (Argo CD), so product teams can ship safely without filing tickets.
• Own the design of multi-region architecture, failover automation, and disaster recovery, with RTO and RPO targets we actually test.
• Operate what you build. Take part in on-call, act as the senior escalation point during major incidents, and turn blameless post-incident reviews into lasting fixes.
• Define the reliability standards for the platform: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, production readiness reviews, and capacity planning that hold a 99.99% SLA as we grow.
• Find and remove scalability bottlenecks across services, databases, queues, and network paths before customers feel them.
• Shape edge and traffic engineering, including ingress, load balancing, DNS, CDN, WAF, and service mesh.
• Lead our Infrastructure-as-Code architecture in Terraform across multi-account, multi-region environments, with policy-as-code guardrails for security and compliance.
• Treat cost as a design input. Partner on FinOps, unit economics, and right-sizing so we scale efficiently.
• Bring AI-assisted engineering (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) into platform work to speed up tooling, runbooks, and incident triage.
• Write RFCs and architecture decision records, review designs across engineering, and mentor senior and staff engineers.
We're Looking For :
• 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps roles running 24/7 SaaS systems at scale.
• Real development depth: You've designed, built, and shipped production services in Go, Python, or Java, not just scripts. You're strong in distributed systems design, APIs, concurrency, and testing.
• Real operations depth: You've carried a pager for business-critical systems, led incident response, and debugged hard problems across the application, OS, network, and cloud layers.
• Deep AWS expertise (GCP a plus): IAM, VPC design, Transit Gateway, ALB/NLB, Route 53, EKS, and managed data stores.
• Production Kubernetes at scale: cluster lifecycle, networking, autoscaling, RBAC, operators and controllers, and GitOps with Argo CD.
• Terraform mastery: module design, state management and refactoring, and multi-account patterns.
• Observability and reliability: hands-on with Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; you've defined SLOs and cut MTTD and MTTR in a measurable way.
• Principal-level influence: You've set direction across multiple teams without direct authority, written design docs that got adopted, and led large migrations to completion.
• Clear writing and speaking, with engineers and with leadership. You can explain trade-offs in cost, risk, and time.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.
Preferred Qualifications :
• You've built an internal developer platform or developer portal (Backstage or similar) that teams chose to use.
• Experience with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and proxies (Envoy, HAProxy, NGINX), plus CDN, WAF, and DDoS protection.
• Experience scaling data layers such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or Kafka, including multi-region or active-active designs.
• Chaos engineering or regular game days in staging and production.
• Security depth: secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, External Secrets Operator), DevSecOps, zero-trust networking, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
• Background in identity, IAM, directory services, or security-focused SaaS.
• Open-source contributions, published writing, or conference talks on platform or reliability topics.
#LI-PD1
Where you’ll be working/Location:

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.

Language:

To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
Why JumpCloud?
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

title: Sr Security Engineer - 11924
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
Why join Coupa?
• Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
• Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
• Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
The Impact of a Sr Security Engineer at Coupa:
Coupa's Security Engineers keep our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data safe. As a Senior Security Engineer, you'll take ownership of complex, ambiguous security problems end to end — building cloud security controls, setting engineering standards, and partnering closely with Engineering, IT, and Compliance to ship durable, automated security tooling rather than one-off fixes. You'll set the technical standard for how the team remediates and automates, and you'll be a go-to resource other engineers turn to when a finding needs real root-cause analysis instead of a quick workaround.
What You'll Do:
• Design and implement multi-cloud security controls across Coupa's cloud environment, including VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, IAM policy design using least-privilege and permission boundaries, and Organizations/SCPs for guardrails at scale.
• Build policy as code and IaC security guardrails and wire them into CI/CD as pre-merge and pre-deploy gates rather than after-the-fact reviews.
• Harden containerized workloads and Kubernetes clusters — image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, network policies, and container/workload runtime detection.
• Own vulnerability analysis of application packages, container images, and third-party dependencies; triage findings by exploitability and business impact rather than CVSS score alone.
• Design and implement remediations (not just report findings) including secure code fixes, cloud configuration changes, and IAM policy adjustments using least-privilege principles.
• Support incident response and forensics as a technical contributor — log analysis, root-cause investigation, and remediation validation using cloud-native and EDR tooling.
• Partner with the Risk & Compliance team to provide technical evidence and control validation for audit frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP).
• Support and mentor other security engineers — reviewing designs and remediation plans, sharing root-cause analysis techniques, and helping less experienced teammates work through complex or ambiguous findings.
• Participate in the on-call/incident rotation and help continuously improve remediation and response runbooks.
What You Will Bring to Coupa:
• 5+ years of experience in security engineering or cloud operations, with a track record of independently owning complex assessments from scoping through remediation.
• Practical experience with cloud security fundamentals (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — IAM, networking, and common misconfiguration classes — sufficient to both find and fix cloud findings.
• Strong scripting/automation skills in Python, Bash, or JavaScript, with experience building or extending internal security tooling.
• Experience with dependency/container vulnerability scanning tools and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.
• Working knowledge of common compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) and what auditable evidence looks like.
• Critical thinking and root-cause analysis skills — comfortable digging past a scanner's output to understand and explain why a vulnerability exists.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills for translating technical findings into remediation guidance for engineers and risk context for stakeholders.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Relevant certifications a plus: CISSP, CCSP, CISA, or AWS/GCP security certifications.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
