The Team
You'll join the team building Atlan's context layer, the platforms that make it possible and the vertical agents that run on it. The platform is what any agent needs before an enterprise will trust it: a registry of which agents and skills exist, traces and evals on every run, and governance over cost and access.
Vertical agents each do one specific job, for customers and for Atlan's own teams. Inside Atlan they already run real work. There's an agent our CSMs trust, three GTM agents that replace 3,000 calls made by hand, an agent that watches every page on atlan.com, and one that monitors the other agents. We write up what we learn in the open at Becoming Frontier.
The team works in small "two-slice" units. You own one initiative, usually with one or two people alongside you, and you decide how it gets built.
What will you do?
You'll take problems nobody has fully defined yet and ship working systems, fast. Depending on where you're matched, you may:
• Own a 0→1 initiative from problem to production. Frame it, write the spec when there isn't one, pick the architecture and build it.
• Build agents with the people who own the outcome, inside Atlan or at a customer. Scope the workflow with them, demo early and put the agent where the work already happens, like an approval in Slack or a redline in a legal team's Word doc.
• Earn autonomy with evidence. Start with shadow runs, study the misses and widen what the agent can do as results support it.
• Design for failure. Decide what happens when a tool is down, context is thin or the agent isn't sure, and how a person takes over.
• Make the engineering calls on what stays deterministic code and what needs a model, build vs. reuse, model choice, cost and reliability. Explain the trade-offs clearly.
• Make agent behavior observable. Tie traces and evals to the revision that ran. Track consistency, cost and latency alongside success rate, and treat drift as a regression.
• Build on and extend the context layer, agent platform and registry: versioned skills, layered instructions, explicit permissions for tools and secrets, and model changes handled as migrations with evals rerun before promotion.
• Build AI-native yourself. Run coding agents on your own work, keep their skills and instructions up to date, and review what they write for architectural drift.
• Share what you learn. Turn what works into skills, reference architectures and quality gates that others adopt, and demo what you've built.
What makes you a great match for us?
Must have
• You've built software systems hands-on and shipped 0→1 products or platforms into production, often without a spec.
• You've shipped agents or LLM systems that real people use. When one went wrong, you traced it back to the context, tool call or decision that caused it.
• You use evals to find and fix real problems, check what a score actually counts, and judge agents by user impact: hours saved, error rate or cycle time.
• You design for failure first: what the agent may touch, what happens when it's wrong, and where a person approves before it acts.
• You build with coding agents every day and hold what they write to the same bar as your own code.
• You're a critical optimist. You believe what agents can do is real, and test what still fails before trusting them with more.
• You reason from first principles. When a familiar design doesn't fit, or a better model makes old scaffolding unnecessary, you notice and rebuild.
• You have strong systems judgment. You can design for production reliability, latency, cost and security, build it yourself, and leave it in a shape others can build on.
• You do your best work owning an initiative with one or two people alongside you, and don't need a large team to feel effective.
Strong bonus
• Experience with MCP, A2A, agent frameworks and runtimes, LLM gateways or agent observability, or you've built an agent harness or orchestration layer yourself.
• Experience with knowledge graphs, vector search, retrieval or semantic layers.
• You've built an eval suite from scratch, or run shadow evaluations, LLM grading or staged rollouts.
• You've shipped agents that write to a system of record, with permissions, approvals and an audit trail.
• You've led AI adoption inside an engineering or business team and can show the before and after.
• Founding-engineer, technical-founder or early-stage startup experience, where you built something from nothing.
• A public trail of work, repos, demos, write-ups or talks, that shows how you build.
This role probably isn't for you if you want to manage a large team, want a well-scoped backlog handed to you, would rather build demos than run agents in production, or are still planning to get into AI.
Why Atlan?
Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:
• Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
• AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.
• Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.
• Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.
• Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.
• Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.
More About Us
Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”
We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.
To learn more, visit www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

title: Product User Research, Intern
description:
About Sarvam AI
Sarvam AI is building India's sovereign AI stack, spanning foundational models, infrastructure and applications. Our mission is to make powerful AI accessible and useful for India, building technology that works across languages, industries and real-world use cases.
As we continue to build and scale our products, understanding how people interact with them becomes increasingly important. We're looking for a curious and research-oriented intern to help us understand our users better and shape the experiences we build.
The Role
As a Product User Research Intern, you'll work closely with our product, design and engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify friction points and uncover opportunities to improve our products.
You'll interact directly with developers, product managers and founders, study how they use Sarvam's products, and translate your findings into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions.
This is an opportunity to work on a new user research function at Sarvam, helping establish research practices and processes from the ground up. You'll also get ownership of a primary product area and the opportunity to see your research translate into real product improvements.
What You'll Work On
• Understand our users: Conduct user interviews, surveys and usability studies with developers, PMs and founders to understand their needs, behaviours and challenges.
• Improve product experiences: Research user journeys across Sarvam's developer console, playground, API documentation and applications. Identify friction points across onboarding, API key creation, first API calls, billing and other key workflows.
• Study developer journeys: Analyse the developer funnel, from sign-up to making the first API call and eventually becoming a paying user. Understand where users drop off and, more importantly, why.
• Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products.
• Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams.
• Build the research practice: Help establish research playbooks, interview templates, participant recruitment processes and a research repository that can scale with the team.
What We're Looking For
• Strong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do.
• Comfortable speaking with users, conducting interviews and asking thoughtful, unbiased questions.
• Technical fluency — you should be comfortable reading API documentation, making basic API calls using tools like Postman, curl or Python, and understanding what might have gone wrong when an API fails.
• Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations.
• Familiarity with AI tools and developer products, and an interest in exploring how they can improve research workflows.
Good to Have
• Experience with SQL or product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Metabase.
• Familiarity with user research methodologies, usability testing and survey design.
• Experience reviewing Figma prototypes or conducting user interviews.
• Previous research projects, internships or personal projects involving products you've built or shipped.
• Fluency in one or more Indian languages.
Who Can Apply?
• Final-year students or graduates who have completed their studies within the last 12 months.
• Candidates from engineering, psychology, economics, design or social science backgrounds.
• Individuals who can commit to a full-time, 6-month, in-office internship in Bengaluru.
What You'll Get
• The opportunity to help build Sarvam's user research function from the ground up.
• Direct exposure to product, design and engineering teams working on India's sovereign AI ecosystem.
• Hands-on experience researching developer products and real-world AI applications.
• Ownership of meaningful research projects with findings that directly influence product decisions.
• An opportunity to work closely with experienced product leaders and learn how research translates into better products.
• Potential for a pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance.

title: Network Operation Engineering  I
description:

​

• ​Basic understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF).
• ​Familiarity with firewalls, routers, and switches (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent).
• ​Knowledge of monitoring and ticketing systems (e.g., SolarWinds, Nagios, ServiceNow).
• ​Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

title: Senior Product Manager - Monetisation & Payments
description:
InMobi (Corporate)
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.
InMobi Advertising
InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
Glance
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
About Accelerate:
Accelerate is InMobi’s AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate’s agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. The product team is organized by capability, not segment. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager, alongside Customer Experience Core (campaign creation, onboarding and activation).
About the role:
You will build Accelerate’s payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.
What you will own:
• Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
• Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
• Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
• Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
• Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
• Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
• Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate’s success framework depends on your system.
What we’re looking for:
• 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
• You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
• Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
• Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
• Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
• You work AI-native (see “How we work” below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
• Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.
Strong pluses
• You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
• Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
• Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
• Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
• Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.
How we work:
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:
• Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
• Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
• Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
• Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
• Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.
Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.
Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.
Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.
This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

Senior Product Manager / Group Product Manager — GTM, TV (OEM, Operator & Strategic Partnerships)
Location: Bangalore, India
Team: Go-To-Market (GTM)
About Glance
Glance is building the intelligent first screen for connected TV — the screen viewers see before anything else — spanning content, commerce, and services for households across the US and other global markets. Partnerships with the world's leading TV makers, pay-TV operators, and technology platforms are central to our growth.
About the Role
This role sits at the forefront of where product management and television itself is heading.
For decades, turning on a TV meant passively picking up wherever broadcast left oﬀ. We are shifting that behavior: the TV's first screen becomes an intelligent, personalized surface that anticipates what a household wants content, services, commerce before a single app is opened. The person in this role is one of the people making that shift happen, device by device and market by market.
You will own
Glance's TV partner-integration portfolio end to end: all TV OEM and pay-TV operator integrations across markets, from initial technical scoping through launch and scale, and productizing our strategic technology partnerships with leading content, entertainment, travel, commerce, and music platforms.
This is a high-ownership role. You will work directly with partner product and engineering teams and with Glance's engineering, design, legal, and GTM teams across Bangalore and the US. There is no coordination layer to hide behind - you own your portfolio's outcomes, and you deliver them hands-on.
What You'll Do
• Own the roadmap and delivery for TV OEM and operator integrations across platforms (Android TV / Google TV incl. Operator Tier, and proprietary OEM platforms) - first-screen and screensaver placements, default-experience agreements, hub/launcher integrations, firmware/OTA paths.
• Constantly scan the platform landscape for the next integration surface that puts Glance on more devices and treat every integration as a growth lever: understand how TVs ship, how software gets placed, set as default, and activated, and design for footprint, activation, engagement, and revenue, not just technical completion.
• Productize partnerships with leading content, entertainment, travel, commerce, and music platforms - APIs, deep links, embedded experiences, tune-in surfaces, and transactional/agentic commerce flows and translate partnership agreements into product requirements, deliverables, and KPIs that both sides are held to.
• Own launch readiness and post-launch optimization across engineering, design, legal, marketing, and partner teams; be the product voice in partner reviews and QBRs.
How You Work
• AI-first, prototype-first. Working in an AI-first way is a baseline expectation, not a plus.
• You use AI tools across research, analysis, and spec-writing and you design and prototype yourself: interactive prototypes and design explorations that let partners and leadership react to something real, before engineering writes a line of production code.
• Ownership and accountability: You run your portfolio like it's your business. When a launch is at risk, it's your problem until it's solved.
• Independent thinking and execution: You form your own point of view, make sound calls with incomplete information, and drive execution end to end.
• Outside-the-box problem solving: Partner integrations rarely go by the book. You find the third option instead of accepting the stalemate.
• Deeply hands-on: You write the PRD, debug integration issues alongside engineering, and are in the war-room at launch. This is not a status-meeting PM role.
What You'll Bring
• Proven business impact: Product work that demonstrably moved core metrics - revenue, distribution, activation, engagement and you can point to the numbers and what you personally did to move them.
• Distribution and growth mindset: You are always asking what kind of integration gets us onto more devices, and you understand the mechanics placements, defaults, platform programs well enough to spot openings and drive growth from them.
• 8+ years of product management (SPM), or 11+ years including leading PMs and owning a portfolio (GPM), ideally in platform, ecosystem, or B2B2C products.
• Experience shipping partner integrations with OEMs, operators, or large platforms, where success depended on another company's roadmap and release cycles.
• Strong technical fluency - APIs, SDKs, deep linking, identity/attribution, system-level integrations and sharp commercial instincts about how partnership deals are structured and where product commitments create risk or leverage.
• Excellent communication: crisp PRDs, executive-ready partner updates, and comfort representing the company externally.
• Experience with TV platform ecosystems or content/commerce partnerships is a plus.
Location & Travel: Based in Bangalore, working closely with teams and partners in the US and other markets. Periodic travel to partner sites and launch markets is expected.
Glance is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.
Since 2019, Glance has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.
Across 5 offices in around 3 countries, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.
Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.
This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.
If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

title: Associate Director, Risk Management
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a senior risk leader to build and oversee the entire risk monitoring program for our international expansion, spanning the United States, Singapore, Malaysia, and upcoming regions. This is a strategic and operational leadership role — you will own the design of the multi-region monitoring framework, lead and scale the teams that run it, and serve as the senior risk voice in expansion decisions.
Reporting into senior leadership, you will be accountable for ensuring that as we enter each new market, our AML, transaction monitoring, merchant risk, and fraud capabilities are not just compliant with local regulation but operationally excellent — rule sets tuned to local typologies, alert quality high, investigation cycles fast, and regulators and partners confident in our program.
The ideal candidate combines deep payments/fintech financial-crime expertise with genuine program-building experience: you have stood up monitoring functions in new geographies, hired and grown teams, selected and implemented tooling, and translated regulatory expectations into working controls.
This role requires close collaboration with Compliance, Legal, Product, Operations, Data Science, Engineering, and external stakeholders including regulators, acquiring banks, networks, and law enforcement across jurisdictions.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Multi-Region Risk Monitoring Strategy & Program Ownership
• Own the end-to-end risk monitoring program for international markets — current and upcoming — covering AML/CFT transaction monitoring, fraud detection, chargeback abuse, and merchant portfolio risk.
• Design the market-entry risk framework: regulatory landscape assessment, typology research, rule/scenario design, threshold calibration, and phased go-live plans for each new region.
• Set the multi-year roadmap for the program: coverage gaps, automation opportunities, analytics maturity, and headcount/tooling investment cases.
• Define and own program-level KRIs/KPIs — alert volumes, false positive ratios, time-to-disposition, STR throughput, loss rates — and report regularly to senior management and board-level stakeholders.
2. Regulatory Alignment Across Jurisdictions
• Ensure the monitoring program meets local requirements across US (FinCEN/BSA, OFAC sanctions, state money transmitter expectations), Singapore (MAS Notice 626/PSN02), Malaysia (BNM AML/CFT policy documents), and each upcoming market.
• Partner with Compliance and Legal on regulatory examinations, audits, and information requests in each region; represent the risk monitoring program to regulators where required.
• Anticipate regulatory change across jurisdictions and adapt frameworks proactively rather than reactively.
• Drive alignment between international program standards and the parent program so global consistency and local specificity are both preserved.
3. Team Leadership & Capability Building
• Build, lead, and mentor regional risk monitoring and investigations teams (analysts, team leads, and future regional heads), with hiring plans that scale with market expansion.
• Establish operating rhythms — quality assurance programs, calibration sessions, case review standards, training curricula — that raise the floor of investigative quality across all regions.
• Develop succession depth and specialist capability (sanctions, mule networks, merchant collusion, emerging typologies).
• Champion a culture of intellectual honesty: investigations that follow evidence, escalations without fear, and post-mortems without blame.
4. Analytics, Tooling & Automation Strategy
• Own the vision for analytics-led monitoring: rules-plus-models architecture, ML-based alert scoring, network/graph analytics for mule and collusion detection.
• Drive build-vs-buy decisions and vendor/tooling selection (TM platforms, case management, KYC/EDD data providers, sanctions screening) in partnership with Engineering and Procurement.
• Set data quality standards for monitoring — transaction enrichment, merchant metadata, watchlists — and partner with Data teams to close gaps.
• Establish A/B testing and champion-challenger discipline for rule and model changes so monitoring improves measurably over time.
5. Merchant & Portfolio Risk Oversight
• Oversee post-onboarding merchant risk programs across regions: ongoing monitoring, periodic reviews, enhanced due diligence for high-risk categories, and business model verification.
• Investigate and resolve portfolio-level anomalies — chargeback spikes, abnormal payment patterns, transaction laundering, misuse of payment services — and drive control changes with Product and Ops.
• Advise on risk appetite for new verticals, products, and markets before launch; ensure restricted/high-risk business categories have proportionate controls in every region.
6. Cross-Functional & External Stakeholder Leadership
• Act as the senior risk counterpart to region

title: AI Researcher Intern
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
About the role
HackerRank is advancing AI-driven Technical Interviewing, assessment of Integrity, and the measurement of Engineering skill to use AI assistance effectively in the agentic era. We are looking for research-oriented M.S./Ph.D. scholars to explore and develop novel Deep Learning architectures and build efficient, trustworthy AI systems. A key research direction is to develop a model-agnostic external Recursive Reasoning Engine that enables smaller models (SLM/SSM/Hybrid etc.) to solve complex, repository-grounded software engineering tasks with greater effectiveness, traceability, and lower inference cost.
Open problems
The agentic era is reshaping every layer of the hiring stack. These are some of the core problems you’ll be working across, none of them fully solved.
• Chakra: Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end.
• Integrity: Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up.
• Evaluation: Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet.
Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time.
What you will do
• Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures.
• Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches.
• Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures.
• Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation
• Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization.
• Design rigorous experiments, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to validate research hypotheses.
• Translate cutting-edge research into scalable, production-grade AI systems.
Who you are
• M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D. in AI/ML or related disciplines.
• 2-3 years of experience in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, or Applied AI Research.
• Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Optimization, and Deep Learning algorithms.
• Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch/JAX, with hands-on model development experience.
• Demonstrated ability to implement, reproduce, and extend research papers, including building neural architectures from scratch.
• Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, benchmarking, and statistical validation.
• Demonstrated research aptitude through publications, open-source contributions etc.
Even better if you have
• Understanding of Evaluation Benchmarks for S/W Engineering Tasks and Human-Agent Collaborations
• Familiarity with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, and scalable ML infrastructure.
You will thrive here if you
• You enjoy solving open-ended research problems and challenging established assumptions.
• You prefer first-principles thinking and rigorous experimentation over simply applying existing models.
• You are excited to explore next-generation AI architectures beyond traditional Transformers.
• You thrive in a fast-paced environment with intellectual freedom, ownership, and direct collaboration with leadership.
• You are passionate about turning novel AI research into efficient, scalable, real-world systems.

title: Senior Product Manager I
description:
Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform
Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.
Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.
You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.
What You Will Own
The search and query platform. Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.
Federated analytics. Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.
Customer context and the knowledge graph. Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.
Data discovery and shared context services. Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.
What You Will Be Doing
• Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
• Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
• Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
• Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
• Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
• Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
• Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
• Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
• Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.
What You Bring
• 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
• Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
• Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
• Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
• The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
• Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
• An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
• Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.
Must Have Qualities
• Platform judgment. Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
• Customer grounding. Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
• Data correctness and trust. Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
• Runs today and builds tomorrow. Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
• High ownership. Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.
About Us
Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.
Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

title: Staff Web Application Security Specialist
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role
We are looking for a Staff Information Security Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department.
In this role, we are building an Adversarial Exposure Validation platform where autonomous agents identify and validate real-world security exposures. As a Staff Web Application Security Specialist, you will shape the platform's web application and API testing capabilities. This is a deeply hands-on role for someone who uncovers the vulnerabilities automated scanners miss and translates that expertise into realistic, repeatable playbooks that our agents run safely.
What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
• Create and refine realistic web application and API testing playbooks
• Evaluate agent-generated findings and exploitation attempts for correctness, evidence quality, and safety, and approve, constrain, or reject execution against guardrails
• Identify coverage gaps in modern application architectures, authentication systems, and multi-tenant SaaS platforms
• Reproduce and validate complex findings manually and safely
• Work with software engineers to improve how the platform discovers, tests, and reports web vulnerabilities
Who You Are (Success Profile)
• You act as an owner with an authentic passion for operational excellence and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and tactical execution.
• You foster a high-trust, collaborative environment that values transparent feedback, healthy debate, and shared team success above individual accolades.
• You champion the customer experience by anchoring engineering decisions in solving critical, real-world problems for both internal stakeholders and external users.
• You bring deep technical curiosity and an innovative mindset to solve complex architectural challenges, continuously seeking more resilient, automated, and scalable solutions.
• You lead with unwavering integrity and high accountability, cultivating trust across organizations through transparent communication and consistent follow-through.
What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)
• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
• Domain Experience: 7–11 years of hands-on web application and API penetration testing, including complex vulnerability discovery across multi-tenant SaaS and cloud-hosted architectures
• Web Stacks & Identity Protocols: Strong understanding of modern web stacks, REST/GraphQL APIs, and deep expertise in identity and authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, session management)
• Advanced Exploitation & Methodology: Hands-on mastery of advanced exploitation techniques (IDOR/BOLA, injections, XSS, SSRF, bypasses, race conditions) guided by deep familiarity with OWASP methodologies (WSTG, Top 10, API Top 10)
• Tooling Expertise: Expert utilization of professional web security tools including Burp Suite, Caido, OWASP ZAP, ffuf, sqlmap, Nuclei, and Postman
• Browser Security & Automation Scripting: Strong knowledge of browser security/client-side attack surfaces (SOP, CORS, CSP) combined with scripting expertise in Python, JavaScript, and Bash
What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies, automated workflows, and custom offensive tooling to drive operational efficiency and augment security testing
• Track record of high-severity findings in bug bounty programs (such as HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti) or published CVEs
• Industry certifications such as OSWE, BSCP, or eWPTX, balanced with proven hands-on capability

title: Account Executive, Platforms Large Users (India)
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopify, Lightspeed and Mindbody. The team’s mission is to help SaaS Platforms use financial services to enhance their mission.
As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will navigate complex organizations and identify ways Stripe can exceed expectations. We’re building something new, developing our sales process, our value proposition and assisting in the creation of key tools and assets, we’re looking for pioneers to join us on this adventure.
What you’ll do
As a Platform Account Executive for India, you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.
You will navigate complex organisations and identify ways Stripe can help them monetise financial services across their business. We’re building this specialisation with the need to develop our sales process, refine the value proposition and create a localised set of key tools and assets. We’re looking for experienced sales executives to join us on this adventure!
Responsibilities
• Own a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with mid-market and enterprise SaaS and Fintech companies in the India region
• Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for upper middle market and enterprise companies to showcase Stripe value in competitive processes, and consultatively apply highly-technical product knowledge from Stripe solutions.
• Identify and engage with high-potential prospective SaaS Platforms, building long term, strategic relationships with them.
• Work with leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) at existing and prospective users to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses
• Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities within India
• Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.
• Develop relationships with executive stakeholders at new and existing clients.
Who you are
You are an adept Enterprise salesperson, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies. You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.
Minimum requirements
• 7+ years of software sales experience selling to large users in the India market, preferably at a technology company, with a track record of top performance
• Deep understanding of the India domestic and cross-border business landscape
• A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales. SaaS Platforms are trusting Stripe to help them monetise financial services, and you have demonstrated a consultative approach to sales, are quick to understand their potential monetisation strategy, and are able to help your prospects articulate the value proposition of embedding financial services to create a SaaS Platform business unit.
• Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies.
• An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them. You are confident in understanding Stripe’s API and having technical discussion with support from Stripe engineers.
• Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
• Strong interest in technology
Preferred qualifications
• Knowledge and understanding of existing and developing payments technologies.

title: Payroll Manager(Bangalore-Hybrid)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
Smartsheet is seeking an experienced, proactive Payroll Manager - India to establish, lead, and scale our regional payroll function as a core leadership presence on the ground in India. In this critical role, you will oversee end-to-end payroll operations, tax compliance, vendor management, and internal controls across India, while partnering with and supporting operations across our expanding EMEA and APAC footprints.
You will drive automation and process improvements, ensure robust SOX compliance, and partner closely with global cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional, scalable payroll service in a high-growth SaaS environment.
You Will:
• End-to-End Regional & Global Operations: Oversee and review end-to-end payroll processing, reconciliation, and validation for India, and APAC (200+ employees), covering regular cycles, off-cycle runs, commissions, bonuses, and ad-hoc payments.
• Vendor & Partner Governance: Direct and manage third-party payroll service providers and local partners (e.g., ADP and Vistra) to ensure strict SLA compliance, accuracy, and seamless service delivery.
• Compliance & Tax Administration: Maintain comprehensive oversight of statutory payroll tax registrations, filings, and reconciliations across India, APAC, and EMEA jurisdictions; ensure rigorous compliance with regional and local labor and tax laws.
• Internal Controls & SOX: Enforce compensation SOX controls, manage segregation of duties, review detailed audit reports, and lead documentation for external/statutory audits and year-end reporting (e.g., Form 16/TDS in India, P60s in the UK, workers' compensation reporting in Australia).
• Stock & Equity Administration: Oversee the payroll tax execution and reporting for stock-based compensation programs, including ESPP, RSUs, ISOs, and NQs across applicable jurisdictions.
• Process Automation & Systems Optimization: Champion continuous improvement initiatives, driving scalable solutions and automation; lead payroll technology implementations and configurations across Workday, CloudPay, and related integrations.
• Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Author, refine, and maintain detailed payroll SOPs, process maps, and control matrices to support global expansion and operational business continuity.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner strategically with People Ops/HR, Total Rewards/Benefits, Stock Administration, Accounting, Corporate Tax, Legal, and Accounts Payable to ensure integrated processes and accurate general ledger entries.
• Employee Experience & Inquiry Escalation: Serve as the regional escalation point for complex payroll inquiries, ensuring timely, empathetic, and compliant resolutions for employees and leadership.
• Other duties as assigned.
You Have:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline (advanced degree or professional payroll certification preferred).
• Experience: 8+ years of progressive payroll experience handling multi-country/multi-currency payrolls (India required; APAC experience strongly preferred), with at least 3+ years in a people management or supervisory capacity.
• Technical Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with Workday and third-party platforms such as CloudPay, ADP, or OSV (Workday payroll integration and testing experience strongly preferred).
• Regulatory & Tax Acumen: Deep knowledge of Indian statutory regulations (PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS/Form 16) alongside a solid working knowledge of UK/EMEA and Australia/APAC payroll tax compliance.
• Governance & Controls: Direct experience operating within SOX-compliant frameworks, managing external audit preparations, and mitigating payroll operational risks.
• Equity Compensation: Practical understanding of stock compensation (RSUs, ESPP, stock options) and the associated withholding and reporting obligations.
• Analytical & Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets (complex formulas, nested logic, pivot tables, data modeling).
• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with proven ability to influence stakeholders and partners across distributed global teams.
• Work Authorization: Legally authorized to work in India on an ongoing basis.

title: Senior Sales Compensation Analyst
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We’re looking for a As the Senior Analyst on the Sales Compensation team, you’ll own the systems and automation that power how Fivetran calculates and pays its sellers. Your focus is CaptivateIQ (or similar compensation platforms Xactly, SPIFF, Varicent), system enhancements, and using automation and AI to remove manual work, improve accuracy, and scale the commission process.
This role reports to the Manager, Sales Compensation Systems and Analytics and partners closely with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Systems/IT, Analytics, Revenue Accounting, and Payroll. This is a full-time role with opportunities to connect and build as a team
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. [If hybrid] Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.
Technologies You’ll Use
CaptivateIQ (or similar compensation platforms Xactly, SPIFF, Varicent), Tableau, or other BI tools
What You’ll Do
• Platform Ownership: Configure and maintain our compensation platform (CaptivateIQ or similar), including plans, crediting rules, quotas, territories, and data loads.
• Systems Enhancements: Own the enhancement backlog end to end: document business requirements and current-state/future-state assessments, then build, test, and release changes with Systems/IT, and lead continuous improvement of program efficiency and best practices.
• Automation: Automate commission calculation, data validation, reconciliation, and statement delivery using platform workflows, SQL, and Python, replacing manual spreadsheet processes.
• AI Enablement: Build and maintain AI-assisted tools and workflows (e.g., LLMs, assistants, agents) for plan documentation, seller inquiries, QA, and anomaly detection, and validate that outputs are accurate.
• Data Integrations & Management: Maintain integrations between the compensation platform, Salesforce, the data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery), and HRIS/Payroll; reconcile and analyze large datasets to ensure accurate quota allocation and performance tracking.
• Plan Design Support: Support the annual compensation planning cycle from design to deployment: plan builds, quota loads, and modeling of plan changes with Sales Strategy and Finance.
• Commission & Quota Operations: Run the monthly and quarterly cycle end to end, including quota distribution and adjustments, revenue crediting, and payout execution, with audit-ready documentation and SOX-compliant controls.
• Stakeholder Support: Serve as the point of contact for sales managers and sellers, resolve complex inquiries and escalations, enforce incentive policy with diplomacy, and deliver training on plans and changes.
• Reporting & Analytics: Build automated dashboards and seller statements that give sellers and managers clear visibility into attainment, earnings, and program performance, and stay current on compensation best practices.
Skills We’re Looking For
• 7 years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, or revenue operations, with hands-on administration of CaptivateIQ, Xactly, SPIFF, Varicent, or a similar platform
• Strong system configuration skills: plan builds, crediting logic, data models, formulas, and integrations
• Automation mindset: has replaced manual processes with repeatable, documented, auditable workflows
• Working proficiency in SQL and Python or similar scripting; experience with Salesforce and data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake)
• Expert-level Excel/Sheets modeling, meticulous attention to detail with large datasets, and strong command of commission logic and plan mechanics
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex compensation scenarios, plus experience writing business requirements documents and current-state/future-state assessments, and testing and releasing system changes
• Clear communicator who can explain plans and technical changes to non-technical stakeholders, with the backbone to enforce policy and the diplomacy to do it well
Bonus Skills​
• Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models
• Built with AI: has personally used AI tools (LLMs, assistants, or agent and automation platforms) to build compensation tools or workflows others rely on, and can explain how they work and how outputs were checked
• Experience with Looker, Tableau, or other BI tools
• Experience at a high-growth tech company supporting a sales organization
• Experience with SOX controls over commission processes
Perks and Benefits
• 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
• RSU stock grants*

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Team:
Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.
The Role:
In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle’s AI and automation infrastructure.
You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.
Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.
The work you’ll do:
Lead complex data integration and ingestion
• Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
• Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
• Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
• Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
• Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
• Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
• Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.
Actions, automation, and AI connectivity
• Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
• Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.
Identity, security, and governance
• Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
• Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.
Customer and team impact
• Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
• Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
• Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.
The qualifications you need:
• 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
• Oracle data engineering experience: hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
• Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
• Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
• Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
• Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
• Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have
• Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
• Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
• Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
• Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
• Docker and Linux server administration experience.
• Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).
What Celonis can offer you:
• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
• Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
• Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

title: Staff, Technical Account Manager
description:
Who we are
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.
Hiring and how we work
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.
See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Technical Account Manager.
About the job
This position is needed to support Personalized customers in EMEA. Twilio is growing rapidly and seeking a a Technical Account Manager to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated technical contact you will work with our customers to resolve complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational vitality.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:
• Use your technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
• Work with our customers’ and partners’ developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
• Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
• Understand customer trends, analyze patterns, drive betterments and report what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process.
Qualifications
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
*Required:
• 5+ years of relevant experience
• Good knowledge of RESTful technology, previous work with APIs and ability to understand and solve issues with cloud solutions.
• Skilled in solving network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS
• Comfortable in working with customers’ developers to troubleshoot use of the Twilio helper libraries.
• Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other groups within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.
Desired:
• WebRTC experience is a huge plus
• JavaScript development experience with broad and deep capabilities to troubleshoot server-side code (primarily Node.js, C# / Java are bonus) and client-side code (React is a huge bonus) is preferable but not essential
Location
This role will be remote, and based in India (Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra and Delhi)
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 5% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
.
Twilio thinks big. Do you?
We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.
Stay alert to recruitment fraud
We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.
