title: Associate, Marketing Technology
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We need a Marketing Technology Specialist for our APJ region. You will be the main contact for regional marketing teams. You will make sure they can use our tools for campaigns, events, and webinars.
Your work will cover three main areas:
• Fix technical issues quickly.
• Set up virtual events, live events, and mail campaigns.
• Train users on our platforms so they can do tasks on their own.

• Regional Contact: Be the main tech contact for the APJ region. Answer questions and fix system problems.
• Events & Campaigns: Build and assist with virtual events and live events. You will be using tools such as ON24, Splash, Cvent, and Sendoso.

• Knowledge of Marketo and Salesforce. You must know how outside tools send data to them.
• Problem-solving skills. You like finding out why a process stopped or why data did not sync between systems.
• A focus on the user. You can explain technical steps clearly to team members who are not technical.
• The ability to manage multiple tasks at once and pay close attention to details.
• Working hours that match the APJ region, plus time to talk with a global team.
Bonus Points
• Certificates in Marketo, Salesforce, Cvent, Adobe Experience Manager, or ON24.
• Past work with field marketing or demand generation teams in the APJ region.

title: Product Manager II - DAU Labs
description:
About the Team
Meesho is the most downloaded e-commerce app in India. As part of the core Business and Product Experience team, we are taking a massive leap from a purely transactional e-commerce platform to a destination for visual discovery and personal inspiration.
We are building an immersive feed inside the Meesho app, focused on look-based, trend-based, and highly personalized inspiration across major lifestyle categories like Fashion, Home, and Beauty.
The DAU Labs team focuses on building engaging discovery experiences, scaling content supply, and solving complex personalization and ranking problems to drive user engagement, daily active users (DAU), and long-term retention.
About the Role
As a Product Manager II at DAU Labs, you will play a key role in building and scaling Meesho's content-led discovery experience. You will work on creating engaging and personalized product experiences that help millions of users discover relevant trends, products, and inspiration.
You will own key product problems across content discovery, personalization, user engagement, and conversion. Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Business teams, you will identify opportunities, drive product improvements, and deliver measurable impact on DAU growth and user retention.
What you will do
• Product Strategy & Ownership: Own key product areas within the content discovery ecosystem, identify user and business problems, and define product roadmaps aligned with DAU growth objectives.
• Discovery & Personalization: Work on improving content discovery, feed relevance, recommendation systems, and personalization to deliver engaging experiences tailored to different user cohorts.
• User Engagement & Growth: Identify opportunities to improve user engagement, daily active usage, session frequency, and long-term retention through data-driven product initiatives.
• Experimentation & Analytics: Drive product experiments, A/B testing, and data analysis to identify growth opportunities, measure product performance, and continuously improve user experience.
• Product Execution: Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into product requirements and drive end-to-end execution.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Content, Category Marketing, Seller Experience, and other business teams to improve content quality, discovery, and content-to-commerce conversion.
• 0-to-1 Problem Solving: Identify new opportunities, solve ambiguous product problems, and build scalable product solutions that create meaningful user and business impact
What you will need
• Experience: Overall experience of 4+ years, with at least 4+ years of experience in Product Management in a tech-led company. Experience in B2C or consumer internet companies is preferred.
• Product & Domain Expertise: Experience working on consumer-facing products, content-led platforms, discovery experiences, recommendation systems, personalization, or engagement-focused products is preferred.
• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical aptitude with the ability to solve complex and ambiguous problems related to user discovery, engagement, personalization, and product growth.
• Execution Bias: Strong bias for action and execution, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
• Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to use data, user insights, and experimentation to identify opportunities, make product decisions, and measure outcomes.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Business teams to drive product initiatives end to end.
• Mindset: Strong passion for Problem First Solving (PFS), ownership, and building scalable products from 0 to 1.
About us

Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
Culture and Total Rewards
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
About Zeta
At Zeta tech innovation is married with exceptional design. We are crafting the best Digital Banking Experiences for the largest financial institutions across the globe encompassing credit cards, commercial credit, deposits, loans, family banking and other financial products and services.
Our Product Design Philosophies
Delight through Design
At Zeta we believe in meticulously crafting digital experiences with delight as a central focus. This philosophy goes beyond mere functionality; it aims to evoke ecstasy in users. The key is to create an emotional connection between the user and the product, transforming routine interactions into memorable experiences. This involves a deep understanding of the product and the user's needs, desires, and pain points, leveraging color, typography, layout to elicit emotion, pleasure and surprise.
Outcome driven UX
"Outcome-Driven UX" is a design philosophy that extends UX beyond the traditional goals of usability and aesthetic appeal, focusing on explicitly achieving tangible, measurable results such as improving funnel conversion rates, retention, and revenue generation. Every design decision is guided by how it can positively impact these metrics. The user interface and experience are meticulously crafted to not only be user-friendly but also to strategically influence user behavior in a way that contributes directly to the company's overall success. This entails an in depth understanding of the business objectives; rigorous analysis of user behavior; rapid iterative Experimentation leveraging intuition and experience, and data driven decisions.
What You'll Do
• Own product experiences end-to-end, from discovery to shipped outcomes.
• Turn complex financial experiences into simple, intuitive, and delightful products.
• Set a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, and attention to detail.
• Leverage AI tools and code to rapidly explore, prototype, build, and iterate.
• Work closely with product and engineering to ship high-quality experiences.
• Drive measurable product outcomes through experimentation and iteration.
• Mentor designers and elevate design quality across teams.
What We're Looking For
• 5+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products.
• Exceptional visual and interaction design skills, with strong product judgment.
• Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted design and development tools.
• Ability to build functional prototypes, beyond static mockups.
• Deep understanding of user behaviour, usability, and business outcomes.
• Strong ownership, bias for action, and comfort navigating ambiguity.
• Ability to influence product direction and raise the quality bar through craft.
Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success

title: PPSL - Growth Management – Acquisition & Retention (Offline Payments)
description:
About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm builds technology that enables small businesses and consumers to participate in the digital economy. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.
About the Role:
We are looking for a sharp, hands-on, and data-driven Growth Manager (Acquisition & Retention) to join our offline payments growth team. This role owns end-to-end growth across two connected pillars: scaling high-quality merchant acquisition and driving sustained activation, engagement, retention, and win back across our offline payments ecosystem (including QR, Soundbox, and EDC journeys).
The ideal candidate combines first-principles business and funnel thinking with strong analytical rigor, rapid experimentation, and practical execution. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics/Data Science, Field Sales/GTM, Risk, operations, and Marketing to turn funnel leaks and lifecycle cohorts into measurable, sustainable growth.
​
Key Responsibilities:
​Acquisition & Onboarding Funnel:
• ​Scale Acquisition & Funnel Conversion: Identify high-potential merchant segments and geographic pockets, optimize acquisition funnels across assisted and DIY/digital touchpoints, and improve lead-to-onboarded and onboarded-to-active conversion rates.
• ​GTM & Channel Growth Partnerships: Partner with field sales, GTM, and lifecycle teams to sharpen targeting, onboarding nudges, and early-stage activation playbooks so acquired merchants reach first meaningful transaction faster.
​
Retention, Engagement & Winback:
• Own Lifecycle & CLM: Drive activation, repeat usage, retention, and winback across merchant cohorts using structured Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM), behavioral triggers, and targeted interventions.
• ​Prevent Churn & Recover Dormancy: Diagnose early drop-off signals, usage decay, and churn drivers across service and product journeys; design and test retention and reactivation campaigns that protect active base health and unit economics.
​Analytics, Experimentation & AI Workflows:
• Build a Data-Led Growth Engine: Track funnel metrics, cohort retention curves, activation velocity, and unit economics; uncover growth bottlenecks and size high-impact opportunities.
• Run Rapid Experimentation: Formulate clear hypotheses, design and execute A/B and cohort experiments, and rigorously measure incremental business impact before scaling winners.
• Leverage AI & Automation: Use AI, automation, and agentic workflows to streamline segmentation, personalization, lifecycle nudges, reporting, and day-to-day growth execution.
​
Cross-Functional Execution:
• ​Partner Across Teams: Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Risk, and Business teams to ship growth improvements quickly and maintain strong execution hygiene.
• Track Benchmarks & Competition: Monitor market trends, merchant behavior, and competitive moves to spot fresh acquisition and retention levers early.
​
What We’re Looking For:
• Experience: 6+ years of experience in growth, lifecycle marketing/CLM, product growth, or commercial analytics within high-velocity consumer tech, fintech, payments, or marketplace environments.
• Dual Acquisition + Retention Mindset: Proven ability to look at the full funnel—balancing top-of-funnel/acquisition efficiency with downstream activation, habit formation, and retention
• Analytical & Experimentation Fluency: Strong command of SQL/Excel/BI tools, cohort and funnel analysis, experimentation design, and metric-driven decision-making.
• Execution Bias & Ownership: High bias for action, comfort navigating ambiguity and cross-functional dependencies, and a structured approach to solving messy operational and product problems.
• Modern Tooling Comfort: Practical familiarity with AI-assisted workflows, automation tools, or data scripting to move faster with insights and interventions.
Why join us:
Work with a high-performing and passionate product, design, and engineering team.
Shape the future of credit for millions of users. Build at scale in one of India’s most dynamic and regulated spaces. Flexible and inclusive work environment with fast decision-making and ownership

title: Technical Writer
description:
About Hevo
At Hevo Data, we’re building the future of data infrastructure for AI. Over 2,000 companies across 40+ countries trust Hevo to power their analytics. As a deep tech company, our engineering team solves some of the hardest problems in data integration, scale, and reliability.
We’re looking for a Technical Writer who goes beyond polishing prose. We want someone who tests the product hands-on, reads connector configs and API references, and verifies every documented behavior before it ships. You’ll use AI tools like Claude to work faster, and you’ll have the judgment to catch what AI gets wrong.
👉 If you can speak the language of engineers and turn complex data integration behavior into docs people trust, let’s talk.
What you’ll do
• Own documentation for new features and Sources end-to-end, from reading connector configuration and specs through testing, review, and PR merge, with minimal supervision.
• Test features in the product: create test accounts and data, run Pipelines, and verify the loaded data in the Destination (for example, with SQL), so every documented behavior is confirmed.
• Read connector configuration (YAML/JSON), API references, and code, with AI help, to understand authentication, sync modes, delete handling, and rate limits.
• Use Claude and Claude skills to draft, restructure, and QA large docs. Critically review the output for invented behavior, wrong links, and unsupported claims.
• Review automation-generated drafts and their open flags, and confirm each point with Product or Engineering before publishing.
• Automate repetitive content such as object tables, ERDs, link checks, and consistent screenshots instead of producing them by hand.
• Raise clear engineering queries and bug reports, with steps to reproduce and expected versus actual results, and track them to closure in Jira and Confluence.
• Work in Git: branch, raise PRs, resolve conflicts, run local builds, and respond to review comments.
• Help evolve our documentation standards, templates, and style guides. When AI output repeatedly needs the same fixes, improve the prompts and skills behind it.
• Review associate writers’ work and share effective research methods and prompts.
What you bring
• 3–5 years of technical writing experience, preferably for SaaS, API, or data products.
• Strong written English and the ability to explain complex technical behavior simply and accurately.
• Working knowledge of APIs and data integration concepts: OAuth and API key authentication, incremental and full loads, schemas, and primary keys.
• Hands-on docs-as-code experience: Markdown, YAML, Git, and a static site generator (for example, Jekyll).
• Daily, confident use of AI tools for research, drafting, and review, including creating and maintaining Claude skills and prompts.
• The ability to read code and config files and write basic SQL queries.
• The ability to set up test environments and test features end-to-end on your own.
• The ability to manage several tickets in parallel, track dependencies on releases and engineering answers, and communicate status proactively.
Nice to have
• Experience documenting ETL/ELT, data integration, or developer products.
• Basic scripting (Python or shell) to automate documentation tasks.
• Experience with ERD tools (for example, dbdocs) and browser automation for screenshots (for example, Playwright).
Why Hevo
• Work on docs for a data platform used by 2,000+ companies worldwide.
• Own your work from spec to merged PR, with real trust and autonomy.
• Work in an AI-forward team that expects you to use, question, and improve the tools.
• Collaborate directly with engineers solving hard problems in data integration, scale, and reliability.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Who we are
Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled and passionate product designer with an unwavering commitment to user-centered design. This passion translates into flawless execution, leveraging a deep understanding of design patterns to create best-in-class experiences across a variety of user journeys that are part of the Mindtickle content platform.
You will play a pivotal role in defining the strategy and vision for managing, generating, and sharing content for our key personas - enablement admin and sellers. Collaborating closely with designers, product managers, engineers, and researchers, you will design intuitive, engaging experiences that help revenue teams succeed.
Responsibilities
• Bring coherence to the content platform workflows, unifying AI content creation workflows and governance into one delightful experience for customers
• From concept to delivery, you will be responsible for defining the user experience, creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
• Deeply understand user needs and behaviors: Conduct user research, analyze data, and synthesize insights to inform design decisions.
• Design scalable, AI-enhanced, enterprise-grade analytics solutions for B2B SaaS.
• Create frameworks and patterns that enable consistent visualization approaches across different feature areas and user journeys
• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams: Work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and other designers to ensure a cohesive and impactful user experience.
• Stay up-to-date on industry trends: Keep abreast of the latest developments in design and AI.
• Mentor and partner with junior designers to share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative learning environment.
Qualifications
• Minimum of 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in product design, specifically in B2B SaaS environments.
• Strong portfolio demonstrating complex problem-solving. Experience with designing AI products is a must-have.
• Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies.
• Strategically builds consensus and trust across diverse stakeholders with competing priorities
• Manages project expectations through appropriate visibility, negotiating scope and timelines to preserve design integrity while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
• Good understanding of design systems, UI libraries, and knowledge of how to build with these.
• Navigates ambiguity and incomplete information confidently
• Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and prototyping tools like Claude Design, Figma Make etc.

What we offer
• Opportunity to shape the future of our platform.
• Competitive compensation
• Collaborative environment with a direct impact on product strategy
• Work alongside top design professionals, sharpening your skills and expanding your design acumen.
• Shape the next generation of designers by coaching and guiding junior team members in a collaborative environment.
Our Culture & Values
We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.
We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.
Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

title: People Operations Associate
description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)
Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.
About this Role:
Behind every seamless workplace experience is strong people operations—and this role makes it all happen. You’ll own the moving parts that keep HR running smoothly, from payroll and compliance to ESOPs, benefits, documentation, and policies. If you enjoy bringing structure to complexity and finding smarter ways to make processes faster, cleaner, and more efficient, you’ll fit right in.
On the Job
• Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing on Keka, including inputs, computation, disbursement, and reconciliation with full accuracy and timely delivery.
• Administer the ESOP programme by maintaining grant registers on EquityList and Excel, coordinating exercise requests, and communicating vesting milestones to employees.
• Ensure statutory compliance across PF, ESIC, PT, and gratuity through timely filings, audit-ready documentation, and proactive risk flagging.
• Own all employee documentation, including drafting, maintaining, and version-controlling agreements, offer letters, policies, and HR documents for accuracy and consistency.
• Manage employee benefits operations covering group health and term life insurance, including endorsements, renewals, and employee claims/query support.
• Maintain POSH compliance by ensuring the Internal Committee is active, managing the complaints portal, and completing annual filings and case processes correctly.
• Track and implement policy updates based on labour law changes, ensuring internal policies remain current and effectively communicated to employees.
• Identify and implement automation opportunities in routine HR operations through tooling, AI-assisted workflows, and process redesign to reduce manual effort.
Must-haves (Min. qualifications)
• End-to-end payroll management independently on Keka/equivalent tool management., including variable pay, reimbursements, TDS computation, and monthly reconciliation.
• Advanced Excel proficiency with compensation trackers, ESOP registers, and compliance dashboards using VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and nested formulas.
• Strong knowledge of statutory compliance including PF, ESIC, PT, gratuity, and labour law basics, with ability to identify issues needing legal escalation.
• Hands-on ESOP administration experience covering grant registers, vesting schedules, cliff tracking, exercise processing, and EquityList/equivalent tool management.
• Familiarity with POSH compliance, including Internal Committee setup, complaints portal management, and timely annual filings.
• Experience managing employee benefits such as group health and term life insurance, including endorsements, renewals, broker coordination, and claim support.
• Skilled in drafting and maintaining employee documentation including offer letters, employment agreements, policy documents, and HR correspondence with legal accuracy.
• Strong process orientation with proven ability to build workflows, maintain clean records, and manage high-volume deadline-driven HR operations.
• Demonstrated ability to maintain audit readiness across HR operations — records, filings, and documentation are kept in a state where they can withstand internal or external scrutiny at any point, not just during scheduled audits
Good to have
• Experience working in high-growth startup environments where HR operations scaled rapidly and processes were built or restructured dynamically.
• Proactive use of AI tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, including document drafting, policy summarisation, and tracker automation
Why join us?
• Own, refine, and build — The foundational processes are in place, but there is significant scope to take ownership, sharpen what exists, and build new ones from scratch. You will not just be executing — you will be the one setting the direction for how People Ops runs at FamPay.
• Scale means scope — We are growing fast, and the complexity of People Ops grows with it. Your role will evolve as we do.
• Make a real impact — From compliance rigour to automating ops workflows, the work you do here will directly shape the employee experience at FamPay.
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck
• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).
• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.
• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.
• Access the latest gadgets and tools.
• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.
• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.
• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.
Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️
FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech
FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
Trusted by leading investors
We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

title: Design Quality Engineer (QARA)
description:
Overview:
Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as a leader in this category. We are seeking talented individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. Candidates will be working with top healthcare providers in the country and leverage RPM's innovation to tackle healthcare's biggest challenges - from resource constraints to quality outcomes, to new care models.
As our Design Quality Engineer, you will be part of Dozee’s QARA – Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs team, embedded with the design team and working with Product, Engineering and Data Science on design controls, verification and validation, and product risk management. It is a high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and who wants to help improve patient care through connected health
Responsibilities
• Play a key role in Dozee’s Quality and Regulatory function, ensuring design quality across software and hardware medical devices.
• Perform design assurance activities and verification and validation reviews, and support product risk management, in line with US FDA requirements and applicable medical device standards.
• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Regulatory teams to ensure product development meets quality and compliance expectations.
• Participate in design and development meetings, providing Quality input on user needs, design inputs and outputs, risk, and verification and validation.
• Review software and hardware Verification & Validation (V&V) protocols and reports, ensuring requirements traceability and compliance with applicable standards, including IEC 62304 for software.
• Facilitate and review product risk management files in line with ISO 14971, including software hazard analysis and risk mitigation.
• Support usability engineering activities, including usability assessments and documentation in accordance with IEC 62366.
• Ensure design documentation, risk files, and validation records are accurate, complete, and audit-ready.
• Partner with Engineering and Product teams to identify design quality gaps, resolve issues, and drive continuous improvement.
• Support design reviews, quality audits, CAPA activities, and regulatory readiness.
Requirements
• Minimum 8 years of medical device industry experience.
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or any relevant field is required.
• At least 3 years of experience working with US FDA requirements.
• Hands-on Design Quality experience with both software and hardware medical devices.
• Experience reviewing V&V protocols and reports, risk management documentation, and design control records.
• Working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and IEC 62366.
• Strong understanding of US FDA regulations (21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485)and medical device design quality requirements.
• Ability to review technical documentation and identify design quality and compliance gaps.
• Ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Regulatory teams.
• Strong documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• High ownership, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining product quality and regulatory compliance.
Skills that set you up to win
• Strong understanding of US FDA regulations, medical device quality systems, and design assurance requirements.
• Ability to translate regulatory and standards requirements into practical guidance for design and engineering teams..
• Strong risk management, problem-solving, and quality remediation capabilities.
• Ability to influence and collaborate with, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Regulatory, and Manufacturing teams.
• Strong documentation and audit readiness skills.
• High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to drive quality standards in a fast-paced product development environment.
Vision & Mission
Save Million lives with Health AI
Dozee is India’s leading AI-Powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS). A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A "Made in India for the World" solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs.
Dozee is adopted by 300+ hospitals and monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries. Dozee has monitored over 1 Mn Patients, Delivered 35000+ Life Saving Alerts and Saved 10 Mn+ Nursing Hours.

title: Senior Business Development Representative – US (Mid-Market)
description:
About Gushwork
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is a modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!
The Role:
As a Senior BDR, you'll own outbound prospecting and qualified meeting generation for Gushwork, focusing exclusively on commercial and mid-market businesses in the United States.
You'll identify target accounts, reach decision-makers through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels, understand their business needs, and schedule qualified product demos for the Account Executive team.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys the challenge of outbound sales, can consistently generate pipeline, and wants to make a measurable impact on revenue growth.
What You'll Do:
• Own outbound prospecting: Identify, research, and engage relevant US-based commercial and mid-market accounts through cold calls, personalised emails, LinkedIn, and multichannel sequences.
• Generate qualified demos: Engage prospects, understand their business challenges, communicate Gushwork's value proposition, and schedule qualified meetings for the AE team.
• Build targeted account lists: Identify decision-makers, map accounts, and prioritize prospects based on ICP fit, business needs, and buying potential.
• Drive high-volume outreach: Maintain consistent daily activity across calls, emails, follow-ups, and other outbound channels while prioritizing quality and conversion.
• Qualify opportunities: Understand prospect requirements, identify potential fit, and ensure meetings meet agreed qualification criteria before passing them to AEs.
• Own pipeline-generation targets: Deliver against monthly and quarterly goals for qualified meetings, opportunities created, and outbound-sourced pipeline.
• Optimise outreach strategies: Experiment with messaging, sequences, channels, and prospecting approaches to improve response rates and meeting conversions.
• Collaborate with the sales team: Work closely with AEs and sales leadership to improve targeting, share prospect insights, and strengthen the overall outbound motion.

title: Lead, Lifecycle Marketing and Automation
description:
About Us
We are a global learning platform on a mission to motivate every learner by empowering every educator.
From K–12 classrooms and universities to corporate training settings, our platform is trusted in over 150+ countries by 75 million monthly active users. In the U.S., 90% of schools use Wayground to engage students and transform learning through technology.
Wayground is a high-growth, profitable SaaS company backed by leading investors including Tiger Global, GSV, and Nexus Venture Partners.
If you're excited about education and international SaaS and want to build towards a mission that you can be proud of, then Wayground is the right place for you.
About the Role
As a leader in Lifecycle Marketing & Marketing Automation, you'll shape how Wayground attracts, engages and retains teachers while building pipeline across schools and districts. Our growth comes through two complementary motions: teachers independently discovering and adopting the product, and schools and districts investing in it at an organisational level. You'll build the strategies, data infrastructure and marketing systems that support both.
You'll identify the highest-impact growth opportunities and translate them into projects, priorities and scalable systems. This requires a combination of strategic thinking and technical depth, from defining audience segmentation and lifecycle journeys to designing automation logic, data architecture, integrations and attribution.
You'll lead the Lifecycle Marketing and Marketing Automation team, setting direction and establishing clear ownership while partnering closely with Regional Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Product and Design to drive measurable business outcomes.
In your first year, success will mean:

• Building a team with clear ownership, a predictable project intake process and opportunities to grow.
Goals
You'll be measured on teacher growth and retention, and on school and district pipeline. Getting there depends on keeping many stakeholders aligned.
1. Teacher lifecycle: drive user growth and retention
• Grow active teachers by turning sign-ups into activated users, and activated users into repeat users
• Improve retention across cohorts, and win back teachers who drift away

• Build TOFU plays that drive awareness, MOFU plays that nurture and qualify them, and BOFU plays that turn them into meetings and opportunities

How you'll drive the work

• Run conversion rate optimisation on landing pages and forms
• Turn results into clear recommendations for leadership
Leading the team
You will manage a small team of marketing automation specialists.

• Coach through regular 1:1s, run mid-year and annual reviews, and build growth paths

What you'll bring

Tools you'll work with

title: Technical SEO Engineer
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
Role at a glance
We are rebuilding our web presence on the same principle we deliver on. The site is a technical asset, not a brochure, and it has to be legible to crawlers, to answer engines, and to the AI agents that increasingly stand between a CTO and a shortlist.
Our category claim is technical. The people we sell to are technical. But our site currently under-performs on exactly the dimensions our buyers would judge us on: rendering behaviour, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and crawl efficiency across a large migration of legacy URLs.
We are not hiring a keyword strategist. We are hiring the person who owns the machine-readable layer of Mactores, meaning the schema graph, the render path, the crawl budget, the redirect map and the performance envelope, and who can sit with an engineer, read the framework code, and say precisely what needs to change and why. The short version: if the fix requires a pull request, you should be able to specify it, review it, and defend it in code review, not file a ticket and hope.
This is a senior individual-contributor seat with high autonomy and direct influence over engineering priorities. You get ownership of a channel that matters to the business, an engineering-led firm that will actually implement what you specify including agent-assisted implementation, and compensation benchmarked to senior engineering rather than to marketing. It is the wrong role if your technical SEO work has been running an audit tool and forwarding the PDF to a developer, if you need someone else to tell you whether a page is server-rendered, or if you are looking to manage a team rather than do the work.
What you'll do?
• Design and maintain a connected Schema.org graph across the site covering Organization, Service, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Person, Event, JobPosting, VideoObject and Dataset, using stable @id references so entities link rather than repeat.
• Decide JSON-LD placement and injection strategy, server-rendered versus tag-managed versus edge-injected, and defend the trade-offs. Debug validation and eligibility issues down to the property level: required versus recommended fields, nesting depth, sameAs disambiguation, and why markup that passes the validator still fails to earn a rich result.
• Extend the graph for AI and answer-engine visibility. Entity consistency, citation-friendly content structure, llms.txt-style surfaces, and how our knowledge graph reads to a retrieval system rather than only to a blue-link ranking system. Monitor structured-data health continuously and treat markup regressions as production incidents.
• Own Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) as an engineering target, using field data (CrUX, RUM) as the source of truth and lab tooling (Lighthouse, WebPageTest, trace analysis) as the diagnostic.
• Take a slow page apart: critical rendering path, render-blocking resources, hydration cost, main-thread long tasks, third-party script budget, font loading, image formats and sizing, caching and CDN behaviour.
• Translate the diagnosis into specific, implementable engineering guidance. The component to refactor, the bundle to split, the payload to defer, the header to set, and then sit with the developers through implementation and verification. Establish performance budgets and CI-level guardrails so wins do not silently regress on the next deploy.
• Work credibly with modern stacks and edge delivery: Next.js, React and Astro-class frameworks, SSR, SSG and ISR trade-offs, CDNs and edge workers, image pipelines.
• Own JavaScript SEO. Client-side versus server-side rendering, hydration, dynamic rendering, the two-wave indexing model, and diagnosing what a crawler actually receives versus what a browser shows.
• Run crawl and index architecture at scale. Log-file analysis, crawl-budget allocation, faceted navigation and parameter handling, pagination, canonical strategy, index bloat, soft-404 and duplication patterns.
• Own technical SEO through migration and replatforming. Redirect mapping and validation, URL taxonomy design, staged cutovers, and pre and post monitoring that catches losses in days rather than quarters.
• Handle internationalization and multi-region delivery: hreflang at scale, regional CDN behaviour, and geo-routing that does not break canonicalization.
• Handle everything a marketing site accretes, including gated content, headless CMS quirks, single-page app routes, programmatic page generation, embedded tools and calculators, video and event content, without losing indexability.
• Instrument what matters. Search Console API, GA4 and server-side analytics, crawler exports from Screaming Frog, Sitebulb or equivalent, and log data, joined and analyzed in SQL or Python rather than eyeballed in a dashboard.
• Build the reporting that separates a real technical regression from an algorithm update from a seasonal dip, and say which one it is with evidence. Bring that technical read into content and IA decisions: where an entity needs its own page, where consolidation beats creation.
What we're looking for?
• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a closely related engineering discipline. This role requires someone who was trained to read and reason about code, not someone who picked up HTML alongside marketing work.
• 6+ years in a dedicated SEO role, with the majority of that time spent on the technical side rather than general digital marketing with SEO as one of several responsibilities.
• Demonstrable in-depth Schema.org expertise. You have designed a multi-entity graph from scratch and can explain the choices you made and what they earned.
• A proven record of guiding development teams through performance optimization, with before and after field data and a clear account of what you specified versus what the engineers built.
• Working proficiency in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, comfort reading a modern JS framework codebase, fluency with Git and pull-request review, and the ability to write Python or SQL for data work.
• Experience owning technical SEO through at least one large site migration or replatform.
• Written communication strong enough that an engineering lead reading your ticket knows exactly what to do and why it matters.
• Sustained availability for daily overlap with US hours.
You'll be preferred if you:
• Come from B2B technology or enterprise services, with long sales cycles, technical buyers and low-volume high-intent search.
• Are familiar with cloud, data or AI subject matter, and can hold a conversation about AWS, data platforms or agentic systems without a translator.
• Have hands-on experience with AI and LLM visibility, meaning how content gets retrieved, cited and surfaced by answer engines and agents.
• Have built your own tooling: crawlers, API pipelines, monitors, or scripts that replaced a manual process.
• Have done edge-compute or CDN-level SEO work in Cloudflare Workers, Lambda@Edge or similar.
Life at Mactores
We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
1. Be one step ahead
2. Deliver the best
3. Be bold
4. Pay attention to the detail
5. Enjoy the challenge
6. Be curious and take action
7. Take leadership
8. Own it
9. Deliv

title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
description:
Who We Are
Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.
Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.
Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.
The Opportunity
AI applications are moving from prototypes to production, and the infrastructure underneath them is becoming increasingly complex.
We build and run the infrastructure behind our AI products: the cloud and Kubernetes platform they run on, the pipelines that ship code to production, and the observability that tells us when something breaks. We're also building AI agents that can operate that infrastructure themselves
We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can work across these areas, build systems from the ground up, and think ahead about how they will behave at scale.
A key part of this role is building AI agents for infrastructure and engineering workflows. We’re looking for someone who has actually built and shipped agents or agentic systems that perform real work, not just used AI coding assistants or experimented with prompts.
What You Will Do?
• Build reliable infrastructure at scale. Design and improve cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, compute, storage, and distributed systems.
• Design for failure. Identify bottlenecks, failure modes, and operational risks before they become production issues.
• Build safer deployments. Improve CI/CD, testing, rollout strategies, and deployment controls.
• Build strong observability. Develop monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational tooling that makes systems easier to understand and operate.
• Improve infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and cloud cost.
• Build AI agents for infrastructure and engineering. Design and ship agents that can use tools and APIs, execute multi-step workflows, troubleshoot issues, or automate operational work.
• Make agents safe to operate. Build the right evaluation, permissions, guardrails, observability, and failure handling around agents taking real actions.
• Raise the engineering bar. Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and postmortems.
• Share on-call ownership. Join the team’s on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and turn what you learn into fixes, runbooks, and automation that reduce future pages.
What Makes You a Match?
• You've built AI agents, not just used AI tools. You have shipped agentic systems that perform meaningful work and understand tools, state, workflows, evaluation, and guardrails.
• You have strong infrastructure fundamentals. You understand distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, and production operations.
• You've built systems through scale. You have taken infrastructure from relatively early stages to meaningful production scale and can talk about the trade-offs along the way.
• You think about reliability by default. Failure modes, blast radius, operational complexity, and recovery are part of how you approach architecture.
• You can debug across layers. You’re comfortable moving from application behaviour to Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure to find root causes.
• You build rather than operate manually. Your instinct is to automate repetitive work and build tools that make engineering teams more effective.
• You've built platforms other engineers build on. Package registries, artifact stores, CI systems or internal developer platforms all count.
• You write things down. At staff level most of your influence comes through design docs and reviews.
Strong signals: Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, or production-grade AI agents. Experience with agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, memory/state, or agent reliability is particularly valuable.
Our stack: AWS/EKS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu, FluxCD, Temporal, VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, Grafana, Go, and Rust. You don't need experience with all of these. Strong engineers from other backgrounds can pick them up quickly.
Why Atlan?
Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:
• Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
• AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.
• Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.
• Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.
• Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.
• Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.
More About Us
Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”
We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.
To learn more, visit www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
Equal Opportunity Employer
Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
Recruitment Fraud Alert
Your safety is important to us. Be cautious of recruiting emails from domains other than @atlan.com. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links — visit atlan.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
Atlan will never ask candidates to make a payment to apply for or obtain a position. We also will never request financial information, passwords, or other sensitive information from candidates. If you receive a communication that you believe may not be legitimate, do not send money or sensitive information. Please report the same on privacy@atlan.com.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Sarvam
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
About the Role
We're looking for product managers who are builders first — people who talk to customers constantly, ship real product to real users, and get into the details of how AI systems behave in production. This is not a role tied to one specific product line. Based on your strengths and interests, you could work across consumer AI products, enterprise platforms, developer tools, speech and voice systems, or edge deployments.
You have 3–7 years of product building experience, have shipped products at meaningful scale at strong B2C or B2B companies in India, and have real, hands-on familiarity with how AI products work under the hood.
What You'll Do
• Own a product area end-to-end — talk to users, write specs, define success metrics, ship, and measure outcomes
• Get into the details of how AI systems behave in production: prompt design, model selection, latency budgets, failure modes, and eval pipelines
• Write code, prompts, and copy when that's the fastest path to learning or validating an idea
• Set up funnels, write queries, and instrument events to diagnose what's working and what's broken
• Work directly with engineering, design, and leadership — no layers, no hand-offs
• Ship product every week, not plans
What We're Looking For
• 3–7 years of product management experience; you have shipped real products at meaningful scale at strong B2C or B2B companies in India
• Currently a product manager — this role is not for people transitioning from consulting, project management, or program management
• Hands-on familiarity with AI: you've built agents, understand how context windows work, and have thought through trade-offs like cost vs. latency vs. accuracy — experience with evals, tool calling, or agentic workflows is a strong plus
• Strong data skills: comfortable writing SQL, setting up funnels from scratch in PostHog, Mixpanel, or similar tools, and defining meaningful success metrics (not vanity numbers)
• Strong product thinking: you start with the customer's problem, talk to users regularly, can structure vague problem spaces, and ship v1 without over-engineering
• Systems thinker: you see the handshakes between components, the failure modes, and the dependencies when you look at a product
• High ownership, high agency: you don't wait for permission, you solve problems, and you've stayed up to fix something because you couldn't let it stay broken
• Clear communicator: you can explain complex technical concepts simply — to engineers, leadership, and users alike
Bonus Points
• You've built at least one working AI agent end-to-end — not a demo, something that actually does a job
• You've used tools like Claude Code, built skills, or set up agentic workflows, and have opinions on when to use agents vs. simpler approaches
• You have side projects, open-source contributions, or products shipped outside of work
• You can point to 2–3 things in your life — product or otherwise — where you went deep and had real impact
Why Sarvam?
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
• High ownership and high impact, from day one
• Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
• You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates
If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Scriptwriter (YouTube)
description:
The Role
We're looking for a Scriptwriter for our YouTube team, someone who thinks in stories, not just sentences. You'll research destinations, understand what viewers are searching for, and turn that intent into clear, engaging scripts across travel guides, ticket explainers, and short-form videos.
This is a search-first writing role where you'll own the process from research and hooks to scripting and performance-led refinement, creating useful, compelling videos that help people decide what to book and continue driving discovery long after publication.
This role is based in Bengaluru. We’re looking for candidates who are local or open to relocating.
What makes this role special?
• Write for what people are searching for. Create travel content that answers real questions people have while planning a trip, with the potential to rank on YouTube search and drive views for months.
• Learn the whole craft. Get hands-on experience across research, audience intent, hooks, scripting, and refinement, building an understanding of what makes a video work from start to finish.
• See the impact of your writing. Understand how your scripts influence views, click-through rates (CTR), and audience retention, and use these insights to make each subsequent script stronger.
• Work with a lean, high-context team. Build your editorial judgement in an environment where clarity, originality, and useful storytelling matter more than polish for its own sake.
What skills do you need?
• Strong writing skills and an instinct for storytelling, with the ability to turn complex or scattered information into clear, engaging, and genuinely useful scripts.
• Strong research instincts: the ability to dig into a topic quickly, identify reliable sources, fact-check details, and uncover useful information that generic guides might miss.
• An ear for video storytelling: comfort writing tight, conversational, spoken-not-written scripts that hook viewers early and work naturally alongside visuals.
• An understanding of audience intent, with the curiosity to figure out what viewers are trying to learn or decide and translate that into relevant, engaging content.
• Ownership and attention to detail: the ability to manage multiple scripts on tight timelines, incorporate feedback, and care about a video's success beyond the first draft.
• Comfort collaborating with AI tools to accelerate research and drafting while maintaining factual accuracy, originality, and editorial judgement.
Bonus Points
• Familiarity with YouTube, SEO, or how search-driven content ranks.
• A sense for visual storytelling and how a script translates into an engaging video.
• An interest in travel, destinations, and helping people make informed decisions about what to experience.

title: Senior Product Manager - Onboarding & Activation
description:
InMobi (Corporate)
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.
InMobi Advertising
InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
Glance
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
About Accelerate:
Accelerate is InMobi’s AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate’s agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager for Customer Experience Core.
About the Role:
You will own Accelerate’s growth engine: getting every advertiser from first visit to a live, performing campaign, and keeping them coming back. This is a Growth PM role with full ownership of user and retention metrics. You will design the journey for each persona, from an SMB owner who has never run an ad to an agency moving dozens of accounts from another tool. You will own signup, ad-account connection, migration of existing accounts and spend history, and the moments that turn a new user into an
active one.You will run experiments, own the funnel numbers, and work closely with the Core Product Experience and Monetization teams, since activation depends on both a great first campaign and a smooth first payment.
What you will own:
• Persona journeys. End-to-end journeys for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise teams, from first visit to steady use. You define what “activated” means for each.
• Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.
• Migration. Bringing existing ad accounts, campaigns and spend history into Accelerate, so advertisers keep their learnings and agencies can move clients in bulk.
• Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
• Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.
• Experimentation. An experimentation practice for the funnel: hypotheses, A/B tests, analysis and decisions.
• Metrics. Signup-to-activation conversion, time to first live campaign, account connection success rate, week-4 and week-12 retention, and activation by persona and acquisition channel.
What we’re looking for:
• 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years as a Growth PM owning activation or retention metrics.
• Growth experience in a B2B or merchant-facing self-serve product (SMBs, sellers, restaurants, creators, developers). Consumer-only growth experience is not enough on its own.
• A track record of moving funnel metrics through experiments, with numbers you can explain: baseline, change, and why it worked.
• Strong analytical skills. You write your own SQL or work directly in product analytics tools, and you know when an experiment result is noise.
• Design sense for onboarding: you know how small details in a flow change conversion, and you partner with design as a peer.
• You work AI-native (see “How we work” below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
• Clear written communication and the ability to align engineering, design, marketing and customer success around a funnel goal.
Strong pluses:
• Experience with ad-platform account linking, OAuth integrations, or migrating users and data from a competing product.
• Built AI-guided or conversational onboarding in production.
• Experience with agency or multi-account onboarding.
• Experience with lifecycle tools and channels (email, push, WhatsApp) and the experimentation platforms behind them.
• Experience in martech or adtech, or time running performance marketing yourself.
How we work:
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:
• Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
• Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
• Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
• Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
• Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.
Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.
Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.
Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.
This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.
If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.
Find out more here: InMobi Culture

We value curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a strong bias toward experimentation and production impact.

title: Senior Manager, Banking Alliances
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
