title: Deep Learning Research Engineer
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
About the role
Hiring is one of the most consequential decisions a company makes. 3,000+ enterprises rely on HackerRank to get it right. We are now reinventing how that works for the agentic era. The AI/ML systems that power this platform are not auxiliary features. They are the product.
Open Problems
The agentic era is reshaping every layer of the hiring stack. These are some of the core problems you'll be working across, none of them fully solved.
• Chakra: Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end.
• Integrity: Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up.
• Evaluation: Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet.
Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time.
What you will do
• Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures.
• Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches.
• Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures.
• Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation.
• Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization.
• Design rigorous experiments, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to validate research hypotheses.
• Translate cutting-edge research into scalable, production-grade AI systems.
Who you are
• M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D. in AI/ML or related disciplines.
• 2–3 years of experience in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, or Applied AI Research.
• Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Optimization, and Deep Learning algorithms.
• Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch/JAX, with hands-on model development experience.
• Demonstrated ability to implement, reproduce, and extend research papers, including building neural architectures from scratch.
• Familiarity with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, and scalable ML infrastructure.
• Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, benchmarking, and statistical validation.
• Demonstrated research aptitude through publications, open-source contributions etc.
Even better if you have
• Publications at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL) or notable open-source contributions in model architectures or agentic systems.
• Experience with LLM evaluation, fraud or anomaly detection, or building systems where the “ground truth” is still being defined.
• Hands-on work taking models from research into low-latency, production inference, such as quantization, distillation, or serving optimization.
You will thrive here if you
• You enjoy solving open-ended research problems and challenging established assumptions.
• You prefer first-principles thinking and rigorous experimentation over simply applying existing models.
• You are excited to explore next-generation AI architectures beyond traditional Transformers.
• You thrive in a fast-paced environment with intellectual freedom, ownership, and direct collaboration with leadership.
• You are passionate about turning novel AI research into efficient, scalable, real-world systems.

description:

title: Senior Product Manager I
description:
Senior Product Manager
Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)
Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.
Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.
You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.
What You Will Own
Playbooks and the automation engine. The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.
Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together. Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.
Integrations, actions, and App Central. Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.
Agentic and human-in-the-loop response. Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.
What You Will Be Doing
• Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
• Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
• Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
• Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
• Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
• Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
• Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
• Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
• Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.
What You Bring
• 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
• Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
• Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
• Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
• The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
• Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
• An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
• Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.
Must Have Qualities
• Platform judgment. Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
• Customer grounding. Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
• Safety and trust. Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
• Runs today and builds tomorrow. Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
• High ownership. Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.
About Us
Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Advanced Threat Protection
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Role
We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.
This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.
We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.
In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.
This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).
Responsibilities:
• Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)
• Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
• Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses
• Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there
• Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited
• Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants
• Establish a deep understanding of Okta Customer Identity products and infrastructure
• Build, deploy & maintain scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize AI threat defenses at scale
• Help meet our operational security commitments by thinking like an attacker, assessing the risk, and advising on mitigation strategies
• Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations and root cause analysis
What this position is not:
• Dedicated application security, code review, or compliance-focused work
• Reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them
Requirements:
• You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks
• You have 4+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security
• You have hands-on development experience — Go preferred — sufficient to prototype tooling, build AI-powered defenses, and operationalize your research
• You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
• AWS and/or Azure security
• Kubernetes
• You have strong knowledge of OWASP (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices
• You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices
• You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams
• You have experience working with a globally distributed and remote team
Bonus points if:
• You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security
• You have built AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment
• You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following:
• Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research
• The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications
• Identity and access management
• Full-stack engineering
• Site reliability engineering
• Vulnerability and threat management
• Governance, risk and compliance

title: Principal Adversary Emulation Specialist (Offensive Security)
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role
We are looking for a Principal Information Security Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department.
In this role, we are building an Adversarial Exposure Validation platform in which autonomous agents find and validate real-world security exposures. As Lead Adversary Emulation Specialist, you will own the quality, realism, and safety of our enterprise attack playbooks. This is a hands-on technical role where you will be responsible for tuning our systems to effectively compose and execute complex chained attacks across diverse security domains.
What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
• Design, review, and refine multi-stage adversary emulation playbooks covering identity, endpoints, networks, and cloud environments
• Evaluate exploitation actions proposed by agents for technical thoroughness, correctness, operational safety, and adherence to execution guardrails
• Reproduce and validate findings hands-on when evidence is unclear or disputed, review validation evidence, and explain attack paths, impact, and remediation to engineering teams
• Own the coverage roadmap for enterprise attack scenarios, prioritized by real customer environments and current threat activity
• Translate offensive security requirements into clear, testable guidance for software engineers while guiding developers on improving platform accuracy, reliability, and workflow
Who You Are (Success Profile)
• You act as an owner with an authentic passion for operational excellence and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and tactical execution
• You foster a high-trust, collaborative environment that values transparent feedback, healthy debate, and shared team success above individual accolades
• You champion the customer experience by anchoring engineering decisions in solving critical, real-world problems for both internal stakeholders and external users
• You bring deep technical curiosity and an innovative mindset to solve complex architectural challenges, continuously seeking more resilient, automated, and scalable solutions
• You lead with unwavering integrity and high accountability, cultivating trust across organizations through transparent communication and consistent follow-through
What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)
• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
• 9–14 years hands-on offensive security experience, with significant depth in red teaming, adversary emulation, and a proven track record of leading full engagements from planning to reporting
• Deep, hands-on expertise in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (including hybrid environments), enterprise PKI, privileged access management, and identity providers such as Okta
• Hands-on experience testing web applications and APIs for complex attack vectors (including bypasses, injections, IDOR, and SSRF) combined with cloud security testing experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Practical understanding of endpoint and detection controls (EDR, SIEM) with experience bypassing them using common red team tools, command-and-control frameworks, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework
• Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell, coupled with technical writing skills to clearly document attack paths, findings, and playbooks
What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
• Experience building, contributing to, or using offensive security tooling, including AI-assisted tools and breach and attack simulation or continuous security validation platforms
• Industry certifications (such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, or CRTE), public security research contributions (talks, blog posts, tools, or CVEs), and familiarity with enterprise Linux/macOS/container environments or LLM evaluation frameworks

title: Account Executive - Startups, Grower (India)
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the India Startups team
India is producing a new generation of SaaS companies, digital-native businesses, platforms, marketplaces, and AI-first startups with global ambitions. These businesses need more than a payments provider. They need financial infrastructure that can support rapid growth, international expansion, new products, and increasingly complex business models.
The Startups Grower team helps Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing startup users realize more value from Stripe. We combine commercial ownership with deep curiosity about our users’ businesses. We work with founders, CFOs, product leaders, and engineering teams to understand where they are going next, then bring together the right people and products across Stripe to help them get there.
This is an opportunity to shape how Stripe serves India’s most ambitious technology companies. You will join a focused, entrepreneurial team in Bengaluru while working closely with colleagues across Stripe’s global Product, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations organizations.
What you’ll do
You will own and grow a portfolio of high-potential startup customers. Your goal will be to build trusted, long-term relationships, retain and expand existing revenue, and help users adopt the Stripe products that best support their next phase of growth.
Responsibilities
• Develop a deep understanding of each user’s business model, growth plans, technical architecture, and financial infrastructure
• Build trusted relationships with founders and senior stakeholders across finance, product, engineering, and operations
• Create account plans that identify retention risks, expansion opportunities, decision-makers, and clear paths to measurable user value
• Lead renewals and commercial negotiations with a focus on durable partnerships, strong outcomes for users, and responsible revenue growth
• Identify and close opportunities for additional product adoption, new use cases, deeper integrations, and international expansion
• Run thoughtful discovery and product conversations that connect Stripe’s capabilities to outcomes such as revenue growth, improved conversion, fraud reduction, faster launches, and greater operational efficiency
• Manage a portfolio with rigor, using data to prioritize accounts, forecast accurately, and focus time on the opportunities with the greatest potential
• Design and execute scaled campaigns for groups of users with similar needs while maintaining a high-quality, consultative experience
• Coordinate across Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Product, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations to resolve complex issues and set users up for long-term success
• Bring structured feedback from Indian startups to Stripe’s Product and leadership teams, helping improve our products, positioning, and market strategy
• Build relationships across India’s startup ecosystem, including founders, investors, accelerators, and technology communities
What success looks like
In this role, success means:
• Retaining and growing a portfolio of strategic startup users
• Increasing adoption of relevant Stripe products and use cases
• Building senior, trusted relationships that extend beyond a single transaction or renewal
• Identifying opportunities early and leading them to a clear commercial outcome
• Creating a predictable, high-quality operating rhythm across account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and execution
• Helping Stripe better understand and serve high-growth companies building from India for the world
Who you are
We are looking for a commercially strong, intellectually curious account executive who enjoys helping high-growth companies solve important problems. You can move comfortably between a founder conversation, a technical discovery session, a pricing discussion, and an internal strategy review. You are equally comfortable going deep on a small number of strategic opportunities and executing at pace across a broader portfolio.
If you meet the minimum requirements, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are helpful, but they are not required.
Minimum requirements
• 8+ years of experience in account management, consultative sales, customer growth, or another client-facing commercial role, including meaningful experience in the Indian market
• A demonstrated track record of retaining and expanding relationships with technology companies or other complex B2B customers
• Experience leading renewals, upsells, cross-sells, or multi-product commercial negotiations
• Strong discovery skills and the ability to translate business and technical priorities into relevant solutions
• Ability to build credibility with founders and senior stakeholders across finance, product, and engineering
• Strong commercial judgment, including comfort with pricing, business cases, contracts, and competing customer priorities
• Analytical discipline and the ability to use data to prioritize a portfolio, build account strategies, and forecast accurately
• Experience coordinating complex work across multiple internal teams
• Ability to operate with ownership and sound judgment in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Preferred qualifications
• Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, cloud, developer tools, or financial infrastructure
• Experience working with venture-backed startups, digital-native companies, SaaS businesses, platforms, marketplaces, or businesses expanding internationally
• Existing relationships within India’s founder, venture capital, accelerator, or technology ecosystem
• Familiarity with APIs, online payments, subscription business models, fraud prevention, platforms, or cross-border commerce
• Experience working in a global organization with geographically distributed teams
• Experience with spreadsheets, CRM analytics, SQL, or a demonstrated willingness to learn
Why this role matters
India’s most ambitious startups are building products for customers across the world. In this role, you will help those companies develop the financial infrastructure they need to scale, while shaping Stripe’s relationships and long-term growth in India. The work combines commercial impact, technical problem-solving, ecosystem building, and the opportunity to partner with some of India’s most exciting founders and technology teams.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Platform: Authentication
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.
We're an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.
Our projects include:
• OAuth across Cells: Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells
• Global identities: One user identity that works across organizations and cells
• Token consolidation: Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith
• Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads: OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes
What you'll do
• Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.
• Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.
• Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.
• Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.
• Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.
• Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.
• Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.
• Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.
• Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
What you'll bring
• Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.
• Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.
• Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).
• Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.
• A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance.
• Experience with multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) systems, including data isolation and performance under high request volume.
• Clear, concise written English and comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous company.
• Optional experience: authentication libraries (Doorkeeper, Devise, or OmniAuth), passkeys or multi-factor authentication, workload identity, gateways or policy engines, AI agent authentication, or multi-region architectures. Contributions to identity standards or open source identity projects are also welcome.
About the team
The Authentication group is part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. We own sign-in, single sign-on, OAuth, and personal and service tokens. Our work touches every GitLab customer, and much of it is on the critical path for Cells and for GitLab's AI agent platform.

title: Web Production Specialist
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
About the Role
The Smartsheet website is a high-volume, fast-moving demand channel and keeping it running at that pace requires precise, quality-focused execution. We're looking for a Web Production Specialist to join our Digital Demand team. Ideally, this role is someone that takes pride in doing the hands-on work of building and maintaining web pages, and who also understands that clean, accurate production is what makes everything else possible.
This is a production-forward role. You'll be responsible for authoring and publishing templated pages and components in Drupal, performing quality assurance (QA) across the site, and working in close partnership with both our Web Development team and DXO (Digital Experience & Web Operations) teams to support a steady stream of content launches, updates, and improvements. You'll be part of the operational backbone of a website that drives real pipeline for the business.
This role requires the flexibility to work a swing shift (9:00 am - 6:00 pm on three days and 1:00 pm - 10:00 pm twice a week) allowing for essential real-time overlap with our US office.
What You'll Do
Page Authoring & Publishing
• Build and publish templated web pages in Drupal, following established design standards, component guidelines, and brand requirements
• Execute content update requests accurately — text changes, asset swaps, component updates — with strong attention to detail and consistency
Quality Assurance
• Perform thorough QA on new pages, content changes, and site updates — checking for rendering issues, broken links, content accuracy, mobile responsiveness, and alignment with design specifications
• Regression testing pre and post launch after each Web Development deployment to ensure there are no content, layout or functional issues on our public-facing websites
• Document issues thoroughly and follow up to ensure they're resolved before launch
Cross-Team Partnership
• Work closely with the Web Development team on technical implementations, QA process and standards
• Partner with the DXO team on production queues, workflow coordination, and operational standards
• Collaborate with Web UX Design to ensure production output reflects approved designs
Process & Governance
• Follow established production workflows, CMS governance standards, and naming conventions
• Contribute to documentation and process improvement as the team scales
• Flag blockers, inconsistencies, or quality concerns early — you're not waiting to be asked
What You Bring
• 2–3 years of experience in web production, digital content management, or a similar role
• Hands-on experience with a CMS platform — Drupal experience is strongly preferred
• Strong attention to detail: you catch things others miss, and you care about getting it right every time
• Working familiarity with basic web concepts — HTML/CSS awareness (you don't need to be a developer, but you should know your way around a page), image optimization, and responsive design principles
• Comfortable operating in a structured production environment with defined workflows and multiple active workstreams
• Clear communicator who works well cross-functionally across development, design, and digital experience teams
• Organized and self-managed: you own your queue, meet your deadlines, and surface blockers early
Bonus if you have:
• Experience with QA testing tools, formal QA methodologies, and automated testing
• Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG)
• Experience with project management or ticketing tools (Smartsheet, Jira, or similar)
• Working knowledge of SEO/AEO best practices and ability to properly format page metadata to adhere to those practices
Why This Team
DXO & Web Development is the operational core of Smartsheet's website — the team that makes sure things actually ship. You'll be doing real work with direct impact on one of the company's most important demand channels. If you take pride in clean, accurate production work and want to grow within a high-performing digital marketing organization, this team is a great place to do it.
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve.
Get to Know Us:
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.
If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

title: Systems Engineer II - R&D Business Systems
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a Systems Engineer to help support and improve the internal systems that our R&D teams use to plan, collaborate, and deliver.
As part of our R&D Business Systems team, you’ll administer Jira Cloud, provide day-to-day support for users and systems, and build automations and integrations that reduce manual work. You’ll also support platforms such as Notion, Zendesk, Slack, GitHub, and incident management systems.
You’ll own system administration, configuration changes, automations, integrations, and improvements across Jira and other internal platforms, from requirements through rollout, collaborating with teammates on design and technical review. This role is a good fit for someone with hands-on systems administration and scripting experience who enjoys solving operational problems and improving the systems that support teams across the entire organization.
This is a full-time, hybrid position based out of our Bengaluru, India office.
Technologies You’ll Use
• You’ll work with Jira Cloud (including ScriptRunner, Automations, webhooks, Rich Filters, Forms, and internally developed applications), Notion, Zendesk, Slack, incident management systems, GitHub, and related operational and workflow tools.
• You’ll use Groovy, Python, or similar scripting languages to create and update scripts that support integrations, automate administrative tasks, and improve existing workflows.
• You’ll also leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to assist with scripting, troubleshooting, research, and technical documentation.
• You don’t need experience with every platform listed, but you should be interested in learning and supporting systems beyond Jira.
What You’ll Do
• Configure and maintain Jira workflows, fields, screens, permission schemes, forms, dashboards, and automation rules, following established governance standards.
• Build, test, and maintain automations and scripts that improve R&D workflows and reduce repetitive administrative work.
• Help implement and troubleshoot integrations between Jira and other internal platforms using native capabilities, REST APIs, and webhooks.
• Own assigned components and small improvements from requirements clarification through implementation, testing, documentation, and rollout, with guidance from teammates.
• Contribute to technical designs for scoped system improvements, explain implementation tradeoffs, and participate in configuration and code reviews.
• Provide day-to-day user support, investigate configuration and integration issues, and escalate complex problems with clear findings.
• Administer and maintain internal platforms such as Notion, incident.io, Zendesk, and other business systems, including managing configurations, troubleshooting issues, and implementing automations, integrations, and workflow improvements.
• Support system migrations, data cleanup, and tool rollouts by completing assigned work and validating results.
• Maintain documentation for configurations, automations, integrations, and support procedures.
• Work with Engineering, Product, Support, and Operations stakeholders to understand requests, communicate progress, and flag risks or blockers.
• Support and maintain internally developed applications that extend Jira functionality, including troubleshooting issues, testing and implementing updates with guidance from teammates, and documenting changes.
• Participate in the team’s operational support processes and contribute to planning and prioritization.
Skills We’re Looking For
• 2+ years of relevant experience in systems administration, business systems, or technical application support, including hands-on administration of Jira Cloud.
• Working knowledge of Jira workflows, custom fields, screens, permission schemes, JQL, dashboards, and automation rules.
• Experience building and troubleshooting workflow automations, with an understanding of how to test changes before releasing them.
• Working knowledge of a scripting language such as Groovy or Python, including the ability to create, modify, test, and troubleshoot scripts to meet business requirements.
• Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication concepts used in SaaS integrations.
• Understanding of cloud-based applications, access controls, and the impact configuration changes can have on users and connected systems.
• A methodical approach to troubleshooting, including gathering evidence, reproducing issues, and knowing when to ask for help.
• Ability to break actionable work into tasks, follow through on commitments, and communicate progress and blockers.
• Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to working with technical and non-technical colleagues.
• Curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms, understand the business processes they support, and incorporate feedback.
Bonus Skills​
• Experience with ScriptRunner, Rich Filters, and other Jira Marketplace applications.
• Experience supporting Notion, Zendesk, Slack, GitHub, incident.io, or other similar tools.
• Familiarity with Git, pull requests, and reviewing or testing scripts and configuration changes.
• Exposure to SSO, SCIM provisioning, or SaaS user lifecycle management.
• Experience assisting with system migrations, bulk updates, or data validation.
• Familiarity with SQL, reporting tools, or Infrastructure-as-Code concepts such as Terraform.
#LI-HYBRID
#LI-AV1
Perks and Benefits
• 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
• RSU stock grants*
• Professional development and training opportunities
• Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
• Monthly cell phone stipend
• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Team:
Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.
The Role:
In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle’s AI and automation infrastructure.
You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.
Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.
The work you’ll do:
Lead complex data integration and ingestion
• Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
• Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
• Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
• Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
• Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
• Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
• Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.
Actions, automation, and AI connectivity
• Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
• Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.
Identity, security, and governance
• Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
• Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.
Customer and team impact
• Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
• Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
• Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.
The qualifications you need:
• 8+ years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
• Oracle data engineering experience: hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
• Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
• Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
• Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
• Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
• Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have
• Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
• Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
• Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
• Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
• Docker and Linux server administration experience.
• Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).
What Celonis can offer you:
• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
• Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
• Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
Principal Technical Consultant – AI-Powered Process Automation
Lead transformative enterprise deployments and architect high-performing, multi-application platform environments at the forefront of hyperautomation.
Location: Chennai, India | Work Model: In Office
About the Team
Our Customer Success team in Chennai serves as elite technical advisors for global enterprise teams. We bridge deep software architecture with business strategy, building scalable platform environments that leverage AI-Powered Process Automation to solve mission-critical operational challenges.
The Opportunity
As a Principal Technical Consultant, you will assume architectural leadership for multi-application platform design, execution, and performance optimization. Top engineering talent joins Appian in this role to move beyond basic application maintenance and ensure applications are resilient, scalable, and built to power mission-critical operations at enterprise scale .
What You’ll Do
• Architect Platform Scalability: Build and maintain standards and tools to ensure high performance and resilience with a focus on reusability, schema optimization, data modeling, system performance, and responsive UX/UI.
• Engineered Integrations: Perform hands-on design, development, and code reviews using SQL views, stored procedures, and high-concurrency REST/SOAP web services/APIs.
• System-Level Troubleshooting: Rapidly isolate performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, resource contention, and latency spikes across the entire web application stack.
• Performance Analysis & Profiling: Analyze database execution plans, JVM/memory utilization, and Locust load test outputs to resolve root-cause architectural bottlenecks.
• Technical Communication & Enablement: Translate complex system diagnostics into strategic recommendations for technical stakeholders, while mentoring junior developers on DevSecOps and coding standards.
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Mathematics.
• 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including 8+ years of specialized experience in enterprise web application architecture, deployment, and delivery.
• Technical Leadership: Proven track record of leading technical teams through the full SDLC, gathering non-functional requirements, and defining production readiness strategies.
• Core Engineering Stack: Deep, hands-on expertise in Python and SQL, supported by strong proficiency in JavaScript or Java.
• Data & Middleware Architecture: Advanced experience designing relational data models (SQL Server, Oracle, or MariaDB), custom APIs, and middleware/ESB orchestration layers.
• Infrastructure & Testing: Solid foundational experience with web infrastructure, containerization using Kubernetes, DevSecOps pipelines, and test automation tools (Selenium), alongside performance, load, and penetration testing methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience collaborating within high-velocity, cross-functional agile engineering environments.
• Practical exposure to modern Generative AI integrations, LLM application pipelines, or vector databases.
• Ecosystem Experience: We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.
#Appian #CustomerSuccess #Python #Kubernetes #SoftwareArchitecture
Tools and Resources
• Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
• Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
• Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.
Benefits
Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.
About Appian
Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com.

title: Phone Numbers Operations Specialist 2
description:
Who we are
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.
Hiring and how we work
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.
See yourself at Twilio
Join the team as Twilio’s next Phone Operations Specialist L2
About the job
Twilio is seeking an Operations Specialist to join the team that runs Twilio’s phone number operations globally. This role will work directly with customers to help them port their phone numbers into Twilio, procure short codes and Sender IDs, and have access to phone numbers they require for their applications. The Product Operations Specialist II role is the second tier on the Level 2 team. The Product Operations team is a key part of Twilio’s Super Network, whose mission is to provide the infrastructure that catalogs, orchestrates, and delivers the world's connectivity.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:
• Provide support to Twilio customers inquiries received by email to ensure customers have an excellent experience with Twilio.
• Assess the nature of product or service issues and resolve basic-to-intermediate level problems.Effectively respond to intermediate-to-advanced questions from customers (external and internal) in core areas and basic questions across multiple areas.
• Log customer interactions and tag/categorize issues accordingly, Learn new processes across a variety of subject areas and ensure our operations are running smoothly.
• Respond to and action incoming carrier partner notifications.
• Quickly and confidently manage complex issues in a timely manner for customers and internal teams with transparency with all the respect.
Qualifications
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
*Required:
• Willingness to work flexibly in rotational schedules.
• You have 4-6 years of experience working with global customers in the operations in the customers facing teams, preferably within an eCommerce or Telecommunications organization.
• You have basic technical skills including basic SQL and an understanding of APIs and data analytics.
• You’re empathetic and love working with customers and carriers to solve their problems and questions, backed with data.
• You are detail-oriented with great organizational skills and comfortable with ambiguity.
• You have above average written and verbal communication skills and are able to articulate concepts/ideas in a clear, concise manner.
• You are willing to collaborate with communications partners and players in the industry to resolve issues, troubleshoot, and build trust.
• You have good time management and organizational skills and are comfortable working under pressure.
Desired:
• Hands-on experience in SQL, Looker, Tableau or similar data extraction and data visualization tools.
• Experience & understanding APIs and related technologies.
• Background in telecommunications is desired.
Location
This role will be based remotely in India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi)
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
.
Twilio thinks big. Do you?
We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is the role:
We’re always on the search for amazing people. People who have a deep passion for technology and are masters at their craft. We build highly sophisticated distributed systems, and we don’t take our technology lightly. At Elastic, you’ll have the opportunity to work in a vibrant young company next to some of the smartest and highly skilled technologists the industry has to offer. We’re looking for great team players, but we also promote independence and ownership. We’re hackers… The good kind. The kind that innovates and creates cutting edge products that eventually translates to a lot of happy, smiling faces.
Elastic’s Support team is unlike any other on Earth: while we are spread across 12 time zones and 15 countries, we operate as a unit, as a family. We are massively distributed yet lovingly intimate. The service we deliver is caring, empathetic, and human yet ambitious, direct, and comprehensive. We don’t do it alone, as we are tightly integrated with our core developers in a way that is real, genuine, and never taken for granted. Our team is a dream for someone seeking honest, hard work and rewards. It is a nightmare for anyone afraid to ask questions or be questioned — always forward, never backward. We are not trying to change the world, we already have. We’re just waiting for everyone else to catch up. We have our good days and our not so good days, and we face them together, as a family. We listen. We solve. We guide. We get it. And we’re excited to bring on a new team member to love.
What You Will Be Doing
• Ensuring technical customer issues are serviced within our contractual SLA and managed to resolution
• Maintain strong relationships with our customers for the delivery of technical support
• Resolves customer problems via telephone, email, chat or remote access.
• Have a mindset of continuous improvement in terms of the efficiency of support processes and customer satisfaction
• Work across multicultural and geographically distributed teams
• Contribute to product documentation, customer knowledge base, and best practices guides
• Continuously improve processes and tools in collaboration with the team

title: fraud analyst
description:
what is CRED?
CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true.
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better.
here’s what will be in store for you at CRED once you join as a part of the datascience fraud team:
role overview
as a fraud analyst at CRED, you’ll work at the intersection of data, technology and fraud prevention to identify and prevent emerging fraud patterns across products.
fraud patterns continue to evolve, making it important to identify and address emerging risks and vulnerabilities. you’ll think like an adversary -analyse data and system behaviour, spot unusual patterns and vulnerabilities, and work closely with data science, product and engineering teams to build practical solutions that prevent fraud.
this is a hands-on problem-solving role. you don’t need to be a fraud expert or a deep ml specialist. what matters is strong analytical and coding fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to approach problems from first principles.
what will you do?
fraud detection & analysis:
• analyse large datasets to identify unusual patterns, behaviours and signals that could indicate emerging fraud.
• investigate how fraudsters may be exploiting products, processes or system vulnerabilities.
• develop hypotheses, test them through data and translate findings into practical fraud detection approaches.
fraud prevention & problem solving:
• work with data science and engineering to identify and close gaps in fraud detection and prevention.
• identify new signals and approaches that can improve our ability to detect evolving fraud patterns.
• build and iterate on detection logic and solutions as fraud patterns and attack methods change.
cross-functional execution:
• partner with product and engineering teams across cred to understand new product flows and identify potential fraud risks.
• work closely with engineering to implement signals, controls and other prevention mechanisms.
• operate across different products and problem statements as fraud is a horizontal problem across CRED.
continuous learning:
• stay curious about how systems work and how they can be exploited.
• learn continuously as new fraud patterns, technologies and vulnerabilities emerge.
• bring an adversarial / "hacker" mindset to problem solving , think beyond the obvious solution and challenge existing assumptions.
you should apply if you:
• have 1–2 years of experience in data science, analytics, engineering or a related technical role.
• have strong sql and analytical skills and are comfortable working with large datasets.
• have good hands-on python/coding experience.
• have a basic understanding of data science /ML concepts such as features, models and how models are deployed. you do not need to be an ml specialist or have built fraud models before.
• are highly curious and willing to learn, especially in ambiguous and unfamiliar problem spaces.
• have an adversarial / hacker mindset you naturally think about how a system might be broken, exploited or circumvented.
• are comfortable getting hands-on and working closely with engineering and product to take an idea from analysis to implementation.
• have strong ownership and grit, and are comfortable operating with urgency when the problem demands it.
how is life at CRED?
working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. With the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.
hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.
to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.
there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Staff Platform Engineer

title: Senior Product Designer
description:

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. Sellers today jump between a dozen tools to prepare for a meeting, run a deal, and keep buyers engaged. We're bringing that work into one place, built AI-first, where the system knows the deal, suggests the next best move, and keeps seller and buyer on the same page.
You'll own a piece of the experience sellers use every day to prepare and win their deals, and set the direction for where it goes next. Qualifications

What we offer

• A global product used by enterprise revenue teams worldwide, built by a product team in India.
• A best-in-class design team to learn from.
• Competitive compensation
Our Culture & Values
We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.
We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.
