title: Design Quality Manager (QARA)
description:
Overview:
Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as a leader in this category. We are seeking talented individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. Candidates will be working with top healthcare providers in the country and leverage RPM's innovation to tackle healthcare's biggest challenges - from resource constraints to quality outcomes, to new care models.
Role Overview:
As our Design Quality Manager, you will be part of Dozee’s QARA – Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs team, leading Design Controls, Product Risk Management and Design Transfer activities in partnership with Product, Engineering and Manufacturing, and building and leading our Design Quality team. It is a high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and who wants to help improve patient care through connected health.
• Champion design quality for Dozee’s software and hardware medical devices across the product lifecycle, from user needs through design transfer and design changes.
• Lead design control and product risk management activities with Product, Engineering, Data Science and Manufacturing, in line with US FDA requirements (21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485) and applicable international standards.
• Build and develop the Design Quality team, embedded with the Bengaluru design team.
• Partner with Regulatory on the regulatory impact of design changes and on submission readiness.
Responsibilities
• Drive the redesign of Dozee’s design control and software lifecycle processes, and oversee their consistent use in line with 21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and ISO 14971.
• Lead design quality activities across the product lifecycle, including design inputs, outputs, reviews, verification, validation, and design changes.
• Drive Design History File (DHF) development, maintenance, and remediation, ensuring documentation supports FDA submissions, including 510(k).
• Facilitate product risk management with the cross-functional team so risks are identified, assessed, controlled, and monitored throughout the product lifecycle including input from complaints and post-market data..
• Partner with Engineering, Data Science and Product teams on software lifecycle quality, cybersecurity (FD&C Act Section 524B)and usability (IEC 62366)..
• Oversee design transfer to contract manufacturers, ensuring product specifications, processes, and quality requirements are effectively transferred and verified.
• Lead design quality reviews, audits, CAPAs, and remediation initiatives, ensuring timely resolution of quality gaps.
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to build a strong design quality culture and ensure regulatory readiness.
Requirements
• 8-15 years of experience in Design Quality, Quality Assurance, or Medical Device Quality, preferably with at least 7 years of US medical device product experience.
• Strong experience with FDA design control requirements and medical device quality systems (21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485)..
• Hands-on experience with IEC 62304 software lifecycle and ISO 14971 risk management.
• Experience leading design control remediation or building and maintaining Design History Files (DHF) supporting 510(k) submissions.
• Experience managing design transfer activities with contract manufacturers.
• Exposure to cybersecurity design requirements for connected medical devices, including FDA requirements under FD&C Act Section 524B.
• Proven track building, leading, and developing a design quality team.
• Familiarity with the software as a medical device (SaMD) or AI/algorithm-based devices is a plus.
Skills that set you up to win
• Strong understanding of US FDA regulations, medical device quality systems, and design assurance requirements.
• Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical design and engineering processes.
• Strong risk management, problem-solving, and quality remediation capabilities.
• Ability to influence and collaborate with senior leadership, Product, Engineering, Regulatory, and Manufacturing teams.
• Strong documentation and audit readiness skills, including supporting FDA inspections and notified body audits..
• High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to drive quality standards in a fast-paced product development environment.
Vision & Mission
Save Million lives with Health AI
Dozee is India’s leading AI-Powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS). A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A "Made in India for the World" solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs.
Dozee is adopted by 300+ hospitals and monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries. Dozee has monitored over 1 Mn Patients, Delivered 35000+ Life Saving Alerts and Saved 10 Mn+ Nursing Hours.
Videos
- Science Behind Dozee : Ballistocardiography & Artificial Intelligence
- 100 Dozee deliver 144 life saving alerts and INR 2.7 Cr of saving - Sattva Study
- Dozee saves life of a mother at home
- Leading Healthcare Game changers work with DozeeI
- Introducing Dozee VS

Bloomberg - Oct 21, 2024
From AI Beds to Remote ICUs, Startups are plugging India's health Gaps
News18Oct 26, 2024
Now, You Can Remotely Monitor Your Loved Ones in Hospital With Bengaluru Start-Up's 'Shravan'

Dozee Harness AI for Personalised Patient Care

We trust AI everyday - From Google Maps to Smartphones, So why not use it to enhance patient safety in healthcare?
BW healthcareworldOct 29, 2024
Dozee's AI-Powered System Predicts Patient Deterioration 16 Hours in Advance
A tertiary care hospital study published in JMIR, validated Dozee’s Early Warning System (EWS), showing it identified 97% of deteriorating patients, provided alerts ~19 hours in advance, and generated 5x fewer alerts, reducing alarm fatigue and improving patient outcomes.
A study at King George Medical University, Lucknow, and published in Frontiers in Medical Technology demonstrated that Dozee’s automation can potentially save 2.5 hours of nursing time per shift, improving workflow efficiency and allowing more focus on patient care.
A study on remote patient monitoring in general wards published in Cureus found that 90%+ of healthcare providers reported improved care and patient safety, 74% of patients felt safer, and there was a 43% increase in time for direct patient care.
Research by Sattva, an independent consulting firm, demonstrates Dozee's substantial impact: for every 100 Dozee-connected beds, it can save approximately 144 lives, reduce nurses’ time for vital checks by 80%, and decrease ICU average length of stay by 1.3 days.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - GTM
description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to help us build reliable agents that run real businesses , we would like to talk.
About the Role

As an early member of our talent team, you will leverage cutting-edge AI recruiting tools and recruitment analytics to drive speed, quality, and operational excellence while actively influencing company-wide hiring standards.

• Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene and real-time updates within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
• Contribute to foundational talent initiatives, including employer branding campaigns, referral program design.
• Continuously refine internal hiring frameworks, rubric designs, and interviewing guidelines as Gushwork scales.
What We’re Looking For
• 3+ years of core recruitment experience, ideally within fast-growing software, SaaS, or high-tech product companies.
• Deep hands-on expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
• Hands-on experience administering modern Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., Lever, Greenhouse or similar).

• Solid proficiency in Google Sheets for pipeline tracking, metrics reporting, and funnel analysis.

Why Join Gushwork?

• We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations
• Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture

title: SDE2 - Full Stack
description:
About the role
We're hiring two backend-heavy full-stack engineers (SDE 2 or SDE 3) for the Cowork team at Sarvam. Cowork is the agentic side of Indus: users hand it real work, and an agent plans, uses tools and connectors, works in a cloud sandbox, and hands back files, docs and artifacts across web, Android, iOS, macOS and Windows.
The role is full stack, but the centre of gravity is the backend: the BFF that every client talks to, and increasingly the agent harness behind it. You'll ship features end to end, from the API and data model through to the client screens on mobile, desktop and web.
What you'll work on
Most of your time goes into the BFF and the services around it; the rest into client work and the harness, depending on what the roadmap needs that quarter.
• BFF (Chat Service): design and own the APIs that web, mobile and desktop share: sessions, conversations, streaming turns, artifacts, connectors, custom and managed agents. Data modelling, migrations, auth and RBAC, pagination and search.
• Real-time streaming: stream LLM output, tool calls and agent events from the harness to clients over an event bus, and keep it correct under reconnects, retries and partial failures.
• Agent harness and platform: contribute to Panja, our agent harness: tool and MCP integrations, sandboxed execution, file and artifact flows, latency and token-cost work.
• Clients: build features end to end on our Kotlin/Compose Multiplatform apps (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows) and the Next.js web app, so a feature you design in the backend reaches users on every surface.
• Production ownership: observability, on-call, RCAs, and making the system faster and cheaper with numbers to back it.
Tech stack
Python and PostgreSQL are the core; you don't need every item below on day one.
• Backend: Python, SQLAlchemy + Alembic, PostgreSQL, OpenAPI
• Supporting services: Go
• Mobile and desktop: Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows)
• Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript
What we're looking for
A strong backend engineer who has also shipped real frontend work and is happy to keep doing both.
• 3+ years (SDE 2) or 5+ years (SDE 3) building and running production backend services.
• Deep in at least one backend language; Python preferred, Go, Kotlin/JVM or TypeScript/Node also welcome.
• Solid API and data-model design: REST/streaming APIs, PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, indexing, transactions.
• Distributed-systems fundamentals: async processing, queues or event streams, idempotency, retries, failure handling.
• Production experience on Kubernetes or a similar platform, with observability you actually used to debug an incident.
• Has shipped user-facing features on at least one client platform: Android, iOS, desktop or web (React/Next.js). Kotlin/Compose experience is a plus, not a gate.
• Willing to pick up the side of the stack they know less, and to learn agent and LLM systems on the job.
• Clear written communication: design docs, PR descriptions, RCAs.
Nice to have
• Built on LLM APIs: tool calling, streaming, prompt caching, evals, or an agent loop of your own.
• MCP servers or clients, OAuth connector integrations, or sandboxed code execution.
• Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform, or native Android/iOS.
• Real-time systems: WebSockets/SSE, NATS, Kafka, or Temporal-style durable workflows.
• Go services, or performance and cost work with measurable before/after numbers.
• Open-source work or public writing we can read.

title: Lead Video Editor
description:
👩‍💻 The role
As Post-Production Manager, you'll lead video editing at Headout, building the team, systems, and creative standards that make great travel content possible at scale.
We create long-form and short-form videos that help millions of people make better travel decisions. From explaining the London Underground to breaking down museum tickets or navigating an unfamiliar city, our videos turn complicated information into something simple, useful, and engaging.
You'll own creative quality, editorial standards, timelines, and the post-production pipeline while building workflows that help the team deliver excellent videos consistently. You'll partner with producers and writers to improve storytelling and formats, use YouTube performance data to make better creative decisions, and develop editors who can work independently.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll continue editing and independently own a smaller slate of videos alongside your management responsibilities, with lower individual output targets than the editors you manage.
🤩 What makes this role special?
• Set the Editorial Standard: You'll define what great looks like across storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and audience retention. Your goal is to make informational travel content genuinely engaging without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
• Build a Scalable Post-Production System: You'll own the pipeline from asset handover and first cuts to feedback, quality checks, and final delivery. You'll build workflows, templates, and reusable visual systems that help the team produce better videos, faster.
• Stay Hands-On with the Craft: You'll continue editing videos yourself, experimenting with formats, and making creative decisions. You'll balance your own editing responsibilities with leading the team and maintaining quality across projects.
• Build a Team of Independent Editors: You'll lead editors working across long-form and short-form content, owning creative quality, timelines, feedback, and delivery. You'll mentor them, strengthen their editorial judgement, and build a culture of ownership and constructive feedback.
• Shape Stories That People Want to Watch: You'll work closely with producers and writers to improve formats, identify storytelling opportunities, and solve creative challenges. You'll turn information people are actively searching for into content they find useful and enjoyable.
• Use Data to Make Better Creative Decisions: You'll use YouTube metrics, including click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration, to understand what's working and improve future edits. Data will inform your creative judgement, not replace it.
• Make Creative Work More Efficient: You'll experiment with new tools, including AI, to eliminate repetitive tasks and give editors more time to focus on creative decisions. You'll build systems that reduce firefighting, improve consistency, and make every project easier to execute than the last.
💝 What skills & experience do you need?
• 4–6 years of experience in video editing and post-production, with experience leading editors or managing multiple projects.
• Strong editing skills: A portfolio demonstrating excellent storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and editorial judgement. A portfolio is a must.
• Team leadership: Experience leading editors, managing feedback and timelines, maintaining creative quality, and developing team members.
• Strong storytelling instincts: Ability to make informational content engaging and easy to understand without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
• Workflow management: Ability to manage multiple deadlines, streamline post-production processes, and build reusable templates and systems that improve speed and consistency.
• Understanding of YouTube: Familiarity with how editing decisions influence click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration.
• Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of editing software, motion graphics, asset management, and collaborative workflows.
• Feedback and mentorship: Ability to give clear, actionable feedback that strengthens editorial judgement and helps editors become more independent.
• Hands-on ownership: Willingness to continue editing videos while managing and developing a team.
• A systems-first mindset: Someone who simplifies workflows, balances quality with speed, uses data to inform creative decisions, and looks for ways to make every project more efficient than the last.

title: Product Manager
description:

title: Communication Designer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
Experience: 2+ years in graphic/visual design. A sharp portfolio beats a strict years cutoff — show us the work.
As the Editorial Graphic Designer for Razorpay's editorial department, you'll shape how our stories look, feel, and move. Think of the visual language of Eye on Design, The New Yorker, Its Nice That, Vox, The Swaddle, Ugra, Homegrown, The Ken: conceptual, witty, opinionated editorial art — not literal renderings of what the headline says. A story about payments fraud shouldn't get a stock-style padlock; it should communicate an idea. Day to day, you'll move between illustration and information design, and help shape the publication's visual voice as it grows — working alongside editors and writers who care about how stories look, with real room to experiment.
What we expect from you
• A distinct visual point of view, with oodles of personality and wit. Your work should be recognisable as yours.
• Conceptual thinking above all: you turn abstract ideas into visual metaphors. Given a draft, you propose the treatment — illustration, collage, infographic, or a smart type-only cover — rather than decorating the obvious.
• Adept with AI tools and workflows - with the curiosity to stay on top of the newest ones as the industry moves: you experiment early, form your own view on what's actually useful, and build it into how you work.
• Genuine range across mediums: hand-drawn and digital illustration, collage,mixed media, photo manipulation, expressive typography, and AI-assisted graphics/illustration used with taste and craft (curation and finishing, not raw prompt output).
• Strong fundamentals - layout, typography, hierarchy, colour, grid systems - with an editorial (not just product) sensibility.
• Ability to turn data and complex reporting into clear, engaging infographics and data visualizations: charts, timelines, maps, explainer diagrams.
• Comfort designing for long-form digital reading - scrollytelling, interactive charts, embedded visual essays - not just static pages.
• Plugged into visual culture: you follow design trends, internet aesthetics, and editorial art globally - and you have opinions about them that show up in your work.
• Strong self-direction: you take a piece from concept sketch to shipped visual with minimal hand-holding, and can explain your choices clearly to editors and reporters.
Tools
• Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop for graphics, illustration, collage, and layout
• AI image tools (Midjourney, Gemini, Firefly, or similar) as one instrument among many - you know when to reach for them and when not to
• Hand-drawn illustrations are a plus
What you'll work on
• Cover art, hero illustrations, and key visuals for features and essays — conceptual pieces that carry the story's argument, tone, and wit.
• Infographics and data visualizations that make complex reporting (data stories, explainers, research pieces) engaging without dumbing it down.
• Interactive story formats — scrollytelling pieces, interactive timelines, explorable charts, quizzes and calculators tied to stories.
• An evolving illustration and visual style guide for the publication — a system with room for play, not a straitjacket.
• A mix of fast-turnaround daily visuals and longer, high-craft feature pieces, in close partnership with editors, reporters, and developers.
Nice to have
• Motion and interaction skills for storytelling — After Effects for short animated explainers, Lottie or CSS/SVG animation for lightweight web interactivity, scroll-triggered animation and animated data reveals. A real plus, not a prerequisite.
• Experience in a newsroom, magazine, or editorial environment — you understand deadline-driven, story-first design.
• Basic front-end literacy (HTML/CSS) — enough to collaborate with or hand off to developers on interactive pieces.
How to apply: Send a portfolio that shows range - illustration, collage or mixed media, an infographic, and an interactive or motion piece if you have one.

description:

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integrations within our Databricks-based data platform. The role will focus on expanding our data ecosystem by onboarding new data sources, integrating enterprise applications, and delivering reliable, secure, and analytics-ready datasets.
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, SQL, and Delta Lake, along with experience building production-grade data pipelines and enterprise integrations. Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and cloud services is important for collaborating with Engineering and other platform teams on connectivity, deployments, and evolving infrastructure requirements.
The candidate will report directly to the Senior Manager - Business Insights & Analytics and collaborate with Data Analytics, Engineering, IT/Cloud, Security, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.
Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, SQL, and Delta Lake.
• Design and implement a medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) to deliver trusted, well-structured, analytics-ready datasets.
• Build and maintain integrations with enterprise applications, REST APIs, databases, and other source systems
• Developing reusable ingestion frameworks to accelerate onboarding of new data sources.
• Build reliable batch and near-real-time ingestion pipelines with incremental loads, CDC, schema evolution and error recovery.
• Configure and manage Databricks Workflows and implement ingestion and transformation pipelines using Auto Loader and Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines
• Optimize Apache Spark and Delta Lake workloads using execution-plan analysis, efficient join strategies, data-skew handling, partitioning, and SQL query tuning to improve performance and control compute costs.
• Implement Unity Catalog governance, including access controls, lineage, auditing, and sensitive-data protection through masking and row-level security.
• Maintain and support existing data workflows running on Amazon Redshift and Amazon EC2, collaborating with Engineering and IT/Cloud teams on connectivity, IAM permissions, S3 access, deployments, and operational issues.
• Follow engineering best practices, including version control, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and technical documentation.
• Partner with Data Analytics and business stakeholders to translate requirements into trusted, well-documented, analytics-ready datasets.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.
The Role
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB ecosystem problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram and Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
Cool things you’ll do
You’ll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. You’ll also help build the AI-enabled support infrastructure that lets customers and engineers solve problems more effectively.
What you’ll do
• Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence
• Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals
• Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders
• Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements
What you’ll bring
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
The ideal candidate should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas:
• Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues
• Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads
• Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
• Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environments
• Troubleshoot and improve the ecosystem around the database: drivers, connectors, and integrations customers depend on
• Ability to design or assess customer workload evaluations and benchmarks, interpret results critically, and explain performance and cost trade-offs
• Guide customer migrations and onboarding, from workload analysis and data model design through data validation and go-live
• Strong written and verbal communication, customer empathy, and ownership through to resolution
Helpful experience
• Scripting or automation with Python or Bash; working with APIs, SDKs, or database drivers
• Familiarity with cloud data platforms and object storage; Docker or Kubernetes exposure
• Experience with analytical databases or data warehouses, including columnar storage, indexing or partitioning, query optimization, and data ingestion
• Experience supporting database migrations, production operations, or customer-facing technical support
• Familiarity with scripting or automation and with AI-assisted support workflows
• Experience in pre-sales, consulting engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role is a plus
• Ability to understand customer goals and workloads, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and recommend practical solutions is valued
Success Measures
• In 3 months, build working knowledge of the platform, tools, support processes, and customer workloads through structured training and case shadowing
• In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
• In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. title: Operations Manager (FinCrime)
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Financial Crimes Operations team helps protect Stripe’s financial ecosystem while supporting legitimate businesses. We conduct risk-based reviews and investigations, applying sound judgment and operational rigor to identify and mitigate financial crime risks. We collaborate across Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering to build effective, scalable processes and support compliance with applicable requirements.
What you’ll do
As a Financial Crimes Operations Manager, you’ll lead and develop a team conducting complex financial crime reviews. You’ll own day-to-day team performance, help investigators navigate ambiguous cases, and build a culture of sound judgment, accountability, and continuous improvement. Working with cross-functional partners, you’ll strengthen review quality, improve workflows, and help the team scale while balancing risk, efficiency, and user experience.
Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of investigators through regular feedback, performance conversations, and career development.
• Manage daily operations, including workload prioritization, queue health, and capacity planning, to meet quality and service-level expectations.
• Guide the team through complex and ambiguous reviews, ensuring risk assessments and recommendations are well-supported, clearly documented, and appropriately escalated.
• Reinforce consistent application of policies and procedures, partnering with relevant stakeholders to resolve questions and address gaps.
• Use operational data to identify trends, understand performance drivers, and take action on quality, productivity, and turnaround times.
• Partner with quality and training teams to address recurring errors, strengthen investigative skills, and improve onboarding.
• Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, Product, Engineering, and other Operations teams to resolve issues and improve review processes and tooling.
• Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and introduce automation while maintaining appropriate controls and human judgment.
• Translate changing business priorities and requirements into clear team goals and actionable operating plans.
• Foster an inclusive team environment where people raise concerns, learn from mistakes, and take ownership of outcomes.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
• Experience in financial crime operations, customer due diligence, anti-money laundering investigations, or a closely related risk function.
• Experience directly managing an operations team, including coaching, performance management, and employee development.
• A working understanding of risk-based reviews, including assessing business models, ownership structures, customer activity, and relevant financial crime risk indicators.
• Demonstrated ability to manage operational delivery against quality, productivity, and service-level expectations.
• Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting information and recognize when to escalate.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings and provide actionable feedback.
• Experience using spreadsheets, reporting tools, or operational dashboards to diagnose problems and guide decisions.
• Ability to prioritize competing demands, lead through change, and collaborate effectively across teams.
Preferred qualifications
• Experience leading complex financial crime investigations or risk review teams in a payments, fintech, or financial services environment.
• Experience reviewing higher-risk businesses or complex ownership structures across multiple markets.
• Experience improving investigative workflows, quality frameworks, training programs, or case-management tools.
• Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams on operational tooling or automation.
• Familiarity with SQL or other analytical tools for investigating trends and measuring operational performance.
• A relevant financial crime qualification, such as CAMS, or equivalent practical expertise.

location.raw: Remote, Canada; Remote, India; Remote, United States

description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Manager, SOX PMO - Business Process, you'll lead Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance for assigned business processes as part of GitLab's second line. This is advisory work, not repeatable testing: you'll deeply understand how processes work, evaluate risks as the business changes, and help control owners design and remediate controls that hold up to audit. Judgment matters more than procedure. You'll form well-supported conclusions, align with control owners and Internal Audit, and defend positions to external auditors. GitLab already uses AI extensively, and the next phase brings AI agents into our SOX processes. You'll help teams adopt them with confidence, finding creative ways to enable new ways of working while maintaining compliance. You'll also partner with the information technology (IT) SOX PMO on readiness for new systems and applications. This role reports to the Senior Director, SOX PMO, within the Chief Accounting Officer's organization.
What You’ll Do
• Lead SOX compliance for assigned business processes as the second-line subject matter expert, advising control owners who own and operate the controls. Deeply understand each process, its systems and data flows, and resolve open questions and assumptions early.
• Monitor risks from new and changing processes, products, and systems. Help control owners design, strengthen, or right-size controls, and contribute to the annual SOX risk assessment and scoping.
• Evaluate control deficiencies individually and in aggregate, identify root causes, and prepare well-supported severity assessments. Work with management to develop, implement, and monitor remediation plans.
• Prepare auditor-ready technical memos on sampling methodology, scoping, and control rationalization, using independent analysis and sound conclusions. Prepare reports and presentations on SOX compliance status for leadership.
• Lead business walkthroughs and stakeholder meetings, and coordinate with Internal Audit and external auditors throughout the audit. Anticipate questions, support positions with data and judgment, and escalate risks and auditor comments promptly with a recommended path forward.
• Advise on controls for AI-enabled processes and processes that use AI agents. Find opportunities to automate SOX work using AI tools, and validate their output.
• Partner with the IT SOX PMO to assess new systems and controls, including application controls and key reports.
• Develop and maintain accurate process narratives, flowcharts, and risk and control matrices as processes change. Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Legal, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, and IT leaders to help them design and maintain effective business controls.
What You’ll Bring
• Hands-on SOX and internal controls experience in control design, remediation, and deficiency evaluation, beyond testing alone. Experience in the software or technology industry is required; SOX PMO, Big Four risk advisory, or assurance experience is a strong plus.
• A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential (strongly preferred) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) credential.
• A strong understanding of SOX requirements and internal control frameworks, such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.
• Professional judgment and skepticism: verifying facts against source documents, testing the reasonableness of data and conclusions, and recognizing missing information.
• A track record of independently solving ambiguous, novel problems, from defining an approach through overcoming obstacles and driving resolution. Curiosity to understand how processes actually work and keep learning as the business changes.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including concise, accurate, auditor-ready memos and actionable recommendations. Confidence partnering with senior stakeholders and external auditors, including working through pushback.
• A practical, innovative approach to helping the business adopt new technologies, products, and ways of working while maintaining compliance. Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and validating their output.
• Experience with usage-based billing or AuditBoard is a plus.
About the team
The SOX PMO is part of the Chief Accounting Officer's organization. In this role, you'll advise business control owners and partner with the IT SOX PMO, Internal Audit, and external auditors to keep GitLab compliant as processes, systems, and AI use evolve. GitLab is an all-remote company, with flexibility to work from home or wherever you're most productive. You'll need to be available to collaborate with teammates during core US Pacific (PT) and Eastern (ET) business hours.

title: Network Engineer (Hybrid)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
About the team
Smartsheet runs its product on AWS, and the Network Engineering team keeps that environment, and the networks that support our people, reliable and secure. The team combines production network and corporate network engineers into one group, so you will learn both sides of the business from experienced colleagues.
Role summary
The Junior Network Engineer is the first line of network operations: you watch the health of our networks, triage alerts and tickets, and troubleshoot issues, escalating when needed. The role is based in Bengaluru and includes participation in the on-call rotation.
What you will do
• Monitor network health and alerts across AWS and corporate environments, and respond to them within agreed targets.
• Triage and work network tickets.
• Troubleshoot connectivity, DNS, routing, VPN, firewall, and load balancer issues, including office network issues, using logs, metrics, and packet captures.
• Perform routine and approved changes, such as security group updates, DNS records, and access rule changes, following change management.
• Write and improve runbooks, and keep network documentation and diagrams current.
• Join the on-call rotation and contribute to post-incident reviews.
• Work with the rest of the network engineering team, and with infrastructure, security, and support teams, to identify recurring issues and propose fixes.
What you bring
• 2 to 4 years of experience in network operations, support, or engineering.
• A bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Clear written and verbal English, and the discipline to document your work.
• Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing (static and BGP basics), VLANs, NAT, and TLS.
• Hands-on troubleshooting skills with tools such as ping, traceroute, dig, curl, and Wireshark or tcpdump.
• Working knowledge of firewalls and VPNs.
• Comfort with Linux command line and basic scripting.
• Willingness to take part in on-call rotation, including some off-hours support.
Nice to have
• Familiarity with AWS networking: VPC, security groups, Transit Gateway, Route 53, and load balancers.
• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, for example Datadog.
• Scripting in Python or Bash, or exposure to infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
• Experience with an ITSM or ticketing tool such as Jira.
• Certifications such as CCNA or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Advanced Networking.
Get to Know Us:
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

description:

With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer for our data pipeline service to build and work on data pipelines that moves data from various sources to data warehouses. The work is very diverse – all the way from patching software to building new connectors operating on our global Kubernetes compute clusters.
You will be responsible for ensuring the technical excellence for your team and owned services, by contributing to the code, reviewing code, contributing to architectural design and mentoring your junior colleagues. • As a technical leader in the team, you will drive engineering excellence within the technology team, come up with architecture and design, work closely with engineers in the team to review designs, and contribute directly to code.

• 8+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, team-scope technical work to completion
• Experience in architecting reliable distributed systems, with an emphasis on high-volume data management within enterprise and/or web-scale products and platforms that operate under strict SLAs
• Experience and expertise in building back-end services and data systems
• Broad technical knowledge which encompasses Software development and automation
• Experience with use of wide array of algorithms and data structures
• Strong knowledge and expertise in working with Java, AWS, Cloud-based APIs, databases, data warehouses, software design and programming best practices
• Entrepreneurial mindset, excellent communication, and technical leadership skills
• Mentoring and guiding junior staff
• Create and contribute to an environment that is geared to innovation, high productivity, high quality and customer service
• Strong knowledge and expertise in writing SQL queries and understanding of query execution plans

• Understand how to use AI code assist and coding agents to automatically generate code for features, bugs, testing, and investigation
• Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support researching, authoring, reviewing, and synthesizing various SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, Postmortems, Test Plans, and Proposals

Join the team as Twilio’s next Phone Number specialist 1

Location
This role will be based remotely in India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi).
Travel

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
.

title: AI Tool Admin
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
At Elastic, we have a simple goal: to pursue the world's data problems with products that delight and inspire. We help people around the world do extraordinary things with their data. From stock quotes to Twitter streams, Apache logs to WordPress blogs, our products are extending what's possible with data, delivering on the promise that good things come from connecting the dots. Often, what you can do with our products is only limited by what you can dream up. We believe that diversity drives our vibe. We unite employees across 30+ countries into one unified team, while the broader community spans across over 100 countries.
Elastic, makers of the hugely popular open source products Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, and Beats, is growing very fast and so is our marketing team. As a key member of the Marketing AI, Operations and Automation team, you will play a hands-on, critical role in governing and administering the marketing AI tool stack that teams across the organisation depend on. From configuring tools at the system level to reviewing AI-generated content before it goes live, you will be the operational backbone that keeps marketing AI running consistently, safely, and at scale.
Elastic is looking for a flexible and adaptable person with the ability to manage a variety of governance and administration responsibilities across a growing set of AI tools and platforms. This is an ideal position for a self-motivated individual who has experience administering enterprise marketing technology, is process oriented, and has the ability to work in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
What You Will Be Doing
• Own the AI-level configuration, system prompts, and governance standards for every tool in the approved marketing AI stack, ensuring consistency across the organisation rather than tool-by-tool drift.
• Act as the human review layer for AI-generated content and submissions, serving as the final checkpoint before anything goes live when agents flag warnings.
• Enforce the tool ownership model, ensuring every approved marketing AI tool has a named owner assigned before teams begin using it.
• Maintain the internal prompt library, approved-use guidelines, and minimum starting prompts available to marketers across the organisation.
• Partner with the Marketing AI Engineer to onboard new tools and workflows through the appropriate approval processes.
• Surface tool-level usage patterns and review volume to inform resourcing and governance decisions as the team scales.
• Assist in maintaining internal documentation across team knowledge bases, wikis, and the playbooks.
What You Bring
• 3+ years in a marketing operations or marketing technology role with tool administration responsibilities.
• Hands-on experience working with at least one enterprise AI or generative AI platform at an organisational level, such as Jasper, Writer, or Adobe Firefly.
• Demonstrated understanding of system-level prompt architecture and how AI configuration affects output quality and consistency across teams.
• Strong process orientation with the ability to build governance workflows and documentation standards from scratch.
• Familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, or similar enterprise marketing platforms.
• Clear, precise written communication and strong attention to detail.
• Experience working across globally distributed teams spanning AMER, EMEA, and APJ.
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
• Generous number of vacation days each year
• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. recognitions

Security incidents and identifying, reducing and resolving malicious losses and frauds on the ground.
You’ll achieve it by forging strong collaborations with the Business and Operations teams, Operations

security and loss prevention needs for the organization.

Meesho at large.

Develop and Lead the Cluster Security and Investigations Charter for a Region comprising
multiple states.
● Coordinate with stakeholders from Operations and Central Control tower, Legal, Trust & Safety

and prevention strategies.
● Partner with Cluster and Area operations teams to mitigate risk of theft, fraud and other high
impact incidents.
● Performing risk assessment of site & operation model and frame mitigation measures.

nodes.

● Close the audit exercise by ensuring corrective measures and action on the identified
stakeholders (employees/delivery personnel/sellers/ops vendors).
● Create Org and liaisoning muscle to intervene in case of ops disruptions and untoward incidents
happening in different parts of the region.
What You Will Need
8-12 years of work experience with substantial experience in managing a geographically
dispersed security, investigations and loss prevention team, with KRs around detection and
prevention of security and loss incidents.
● Experience in Physical security operations and Investigations, preferably in E-commerce,
Fulfillment, 3P Logistics, Supply chain, Operations, or relevant security experience in similar high
growth tech startups.
● Outstanding organizational skills.
● Superior problem-solving and incident and case management skills.
● Experience in team building, managing, and coaching will be a plus.
● Knowledge & experience of laws applying to police & legal action and the judicial process.
● Ability to travel, sometimes at a short notice

title: AM / DM | Non IT Purchase
description:

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
Role Overview:
The Buyer – Admin & HR Procurement will support end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities related to Administrative, Facility Management, Lease Rental, and HR requirements. The role involves vendor identification and coordination, commercial negotiations, lease management, PR-to-PO processing, cost comparison analysis, contract administration, and ensuring timely availability of services and materials in compliance with company procurement policies.
This position requires strong coordination skills, attention to detail, analytical ability, negotiation capability, and a service-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
1. Admin-Related Procurement
- Manage procurement of office supplies, stationery, and pantry items.
- Coordinate facility management services including housekeeping, security, pest control, and other facility-related services.
- Procure office equipment such as printers, furniture, workstations, and related accessories.
- Support Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) tracking and renewals.
- Coordinate arrangements for corporate events and employee engagement activities.
- Facilitate travel and accommodation bookings as per company policy.
- Ensure timely processing of Purchase Requisitions (PR) to Purchase Orders (PO).
- Maintain vendor database and vendor performance records.
- Conduct cost comparisons and negotiate within defined authority limits.
2. HR-Related Procurement
- Coordinate with employee benefits vendors (GMC/GTL and other insurance support).
- Assist in onboarding and managing Training & Development program vendors.
-Liaise with recruitment agencies for billing and documentation support.
- Coordinate background verification services.
- Manage procurement of employee gifting and onboarding kits.
- Support payroll and HRMS vendor coordination.
- Track contract validity and renewal timelines for HR vendors.
3. Operational Responsibilities
- Ensure adherence to procurement policies and approval workflows.
- Prepare comparative statements, vendor evaluation reports, and commercial analysis.
- Monitor delivery timelines and resolve vendor-related issues.
- Maintain procurement documentation and ensure audit readiness.
- Support budget tracking, spend analysis, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Ensure timely contract renewals and effective vendor performance management.
Skills & Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
- 6+ years of experience in Procurement, preferably handling Admin, Facility Management and HR related requirements.
- Good knowledge of sourcing, commercial negotiations, PR-to-PO cycle, contract management, and vendor management.
- Experience in lease commercial negotiations and lease agreement administration will be preferred.
- Strong analytical and commercial evaluation skills.
- Strong MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
- Good negotiation and coordination skills.
- High attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

title: Senior Compliance Engineer
description:

Hevo is a fully-managed, no-code data pipeline platform that helps organizations move, transform, and activate their data in real time. With 150+ pre-built, battle-tested connectors, Hevo lets data teams focus on insights instead of pipeline maintenance — trusted by 2,000+ organizations globally to keep their data flowing reliably, securely, and in compliance with standards like SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, DORA and HIPAA.

As Hevo's enterprise customer base grows, security and compliance reviews are an increasingly visible part of how deals get done. What You'll Do
• Own and operate our compliance programs (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, DPDP as applicable) end-to-end — control implementation, evidence collection, and audit management
• Be the primary point of contact for external auditors; manage audit timelines and evidence collection

• Respond to customer and prospect security questionnaires (RFPs, due-diligence requests, trust-portal access) with accuracy and speed — a high-visibility, customer-facing part of this role

• Draft, maintain, and drive review of security policies and procedures

What We're Looking For — Must-Haves

• Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable presenting to and negotiating with external customers, auditors, and executives
• Experience responding to customer security questionnaires / RFPs

Nice to Have

title: Senior Information Security Risk Analyst
description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)
Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.
Role Overview
We are seeking a proactive and detailed-oriented IT Risk & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for executing cybersecurity risk assessments for our third-party vendors, suppliers, service providers and internal IT risk management processes. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Risk teams to identify, evaluate, and mitigate technology and vendor risks across the organization.
Must-Haves
• Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity, third-party risk management (TPRM), or information security governance.
• IT Risk Knowledge: Strong understanding of internal IT general controls (ITGC), access control, disaster recovery, cloud security concepts, and data protection principles.
• Framework Familiarity: Working knowledge of industry frameworks and standards, such as RBI Framework for Outsourcing of Payment and Settlement-related Activities by PSOs, RBI MD on Cyber Resilience & Digital Payment Security Controls, ISO 27001, ISO 31000, and NIST CSF.
• Artifact Evaluation: Demonstrated ability to review vendor reports, security certifications, penetration test summaries, and questionnaires.
• Analytical & Communication Skills: Excellent analytical, organizational, and documentation skills with the ability to communicate risk findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
• Ownership: Proven ability to manage multiple vendor assessments and internal risk tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Good to Haves
• Professional certifications or active progress toward certifications such as CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI etc.
• Prior experience working in financial services, technology, or other regulated environments.
• Hands-on experience using GRC tools or dedicated Third-Party Risk Management platforms.
• Basic awareness of AI-enabled features in GRC or risk tools
• Experience supporting IT disaster recovery exercises or business continuity planning.
Roles & Responsibilities
1. IT Risk Management
• Risk Assessment & Identification: Execute internal IT risk assessments across IT infrastructure, cloud environments, business applications, and operational workflows.
• Risk Register Maintenance: Maintain and regularly update the enterprise IT Risk Register, tracking risk treatment plans, remediation timelines, and risk acceptance approvals.
• Internal Controls Evaluation: Assess the effectiveness of internal IT controls, including access management, backup and disaster recovery, change management, and data security.
• KRI & Risk Reporting: Monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and assist in preparing periodic risk reports and metrics for management and oversight committees.
2. Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPRM)
• Vendor Risk Assessments: Perform end-to-end cybersecurity risk assessments for third-party vendors, suppliers, and external service providers.
• Artefact Review & Analysis: Review vendor security documentation, including reports, certifications, penetration testing summaries, architecture diagrams, and security policies.
• Questionnaire Evaluation: Review and evaluate vendor responses to cybersecurity questionnaires, due diligence requests, and risk evaluations.
• Risk Quantification & Tracking: Assign vendor risk ratings, document identified gaps, establish remediation action plans, and track vendor progress on outstanding risk items.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Legal, and stakeholder teams during vendor onboarding, ongoing monitoring, and contract reviews.
• Incident Monitoring & Escalation: Monitor vendor-related security incidents and advisory alerts, escalating potential issues in accordance with incident response protocols.
Why Join Us
• High ownership: Define and drive Fam’s IT risk posture from the ground up—shaping IT, IS & outsourcing risk frameworks.
• Org-level impact: Influence decision-making at the highest levels, working cross-functionally with security, legal, engineering, vendors and leadership to embed a strong risk and compliance culture across the org.
• Zero to one opportunity: Build scalable, audit-ready systems and processes in a fast-moving startup environment where your work directly enables product innovation and regulatory trust.
• Mission-driven: Be part of India’s first payments platform purpose-built for teenagers and young adults—balancing growth with trust, responsibility, and user safety.
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck
• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).
• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.
• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.
Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️
FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech
FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
Trusted by leading investors
We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛

title: Senior HR Executive – People Operations
description:
About 100ms
100ms is building AI agents that automate complex patient access workflows in U.S. healthcare — starting with benefits verification, prior authorisation, and referral intake in specialty pharmacy.
We help care teams reduce delays and administrative burden so that patients can start treatment faster. Our automation platform combines deep healthcare knowledge with LLM-based agents and robust ops infrastructure.
THE ROLE
As our HR Executive, you will run day-to-day people operations for the India team. This is a hands-on role. You will own attendance, payroll inputs, compliance and the employee lifecycle yourself, and you will be the first point of contact for employees on HR matters. We are looking for someone who is precise with process, calm and clear with people, and comfortable in a fast-growing company.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Attendance & Payroll: Manage daily attendance through the HRMS, process shift allowances and overtime, and prepare accurate monthly payroll inputs, including joiners, exits, and full-and-final settlements.
• Statutory Compliance: Manage PF, ESI, PT, LWF, and gratuity requirements; maintain Karnataka Shops & Establishments registers and filings; and ensure HR practices remain aligned with applicable Labour Codes.
• Employee Lifecycle: Own the employee lifecycle from offer letters and background verification through onboarding, induction, HR documentation, and exit formalities.
• Employee Relations: Respond to employee queries and grievances promptly, and handle attendance, performance, and conduct-related matters fairly and confidentially.
• Employee Welfare & Engagement: Plan and execute employee engagement and welfare initiatives, including support for night-shift teams covering transportation, safety, and wellbeing.
• HR Policies & POSH: Draft, update, and implement HR policies covering leave, maternity, attendance, shifts, conduct, grievances, and exits. Support POSH compliance and coordinate with the Internal Committee.
• HR Records & Vendor Management: Maintain accurate employee records and HRMS data, and coordinate with payroll, insurance, facilities, and other HR service providers.

• 4–6 years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or a similar HR Generalist role.
• Experience managing attendance and payroll inputs for a sizeable workforce, including shifts, overtime, joiners, exits, and full-and-final settlements.
• Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance, including Labour Codes, maternity benefits, POSH, gratuity, and the Karnataka Shops & Establishments Act.
• Hands-on experience with an HRMS such as Keka, greytHR, or Zoho People, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
• Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees at all levels. Kannada or Hindi is a plus.
• High ownership and strong attention to detail, with a hands-on approach and a willingness to execute rather than delegate.
• Bachelor’s degree required; a Master’s in HR, such as MBA/PGDM/MSW in HR or Labour Welfare, is preferred.
WHY JOIN US
• Own People Operations end-to-end for a growing team, with direct visibility and access to leadership.
• Shape HR processes, policies, and programs as the company scales and evolves.
• Work at a company applying AI to solve real-world problems in US healthcare.
• Take on a high-ownership, hands-on role where your work directly impacts employees and the organization.
NICE TO HAVE
• Experience working at a fast-growing startup, ideally through a period of rapid scaling.
• Experience supporting shift-based or operations-heavy teams, including night-shift, field, or frontline employees.

title: Lead Analyst - Portfolio Intelligence & Fraud Analytics
description:

You will leverage data, analytics, and risk intelligence to identify opportunities, detect emerging risks, support fraud prevention initiatives, and provide actionable insights to business stakeholders. This role is ideal for a highly analytical professional who combines strong SQL and data analysis capabilities with an understanding of payments, fraud risk, portfolio monitoring, and customer behavior.

• Analyze customer, product, corridor, and market performance to identify emerging trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
• Develop and maintain portfolio monitoring dashboards and reporting frameworks and perform deep-dive analysis on customer segments, transaction behavior, payment flows, and portfolio concentration risks.
• Monitor key portfolio KPIs and KRIs, identifying significant changes and potential risk indicators.
• Conduct ad hoc analytical reviews to support business initiatives and strategic decision-making.

• Support development and optimization of fraud rules, thresholds, and monitoring strategies.

• Develop data visualizations that communicate actionable insights effectively.
• Partner with Data Engineering teams to improve data quality, accessibility, and reporting capabilities.
• Monitor portfolio performance against internal risk thresholds and payment network requirements.
• Track fraud-to-sales ratios, chargeback ratios, dispute rates, approval rates, and transaction-risk indicators.
• Analyze emerging payment-risk trends and provide early warning indicators to stakeholders.
• Provide analytical support for fraud prevention, risk management, and portfolio optimization projects.
Requirements:
• 4-7 years of experience in Fraud Analytics, Portfolio Analytics, Payments Risk, Financial Crime Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Analytics.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience working with large datasets and identifying actionable insights.
• Advanced SQL skills and experience performing complex data analysis.
• Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.
• Experience building dashboards and visualizations using Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
• Understanding of payment ecosystems, fraud typologies, chargebacks, and transaction-risk indicators.
• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• Ability to present analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Preferred Qualifications
• Experience within fintech, payments, banking, card issuing, or acquiring environments.
• Knowledge of Visa and Mastercard fraud monitoring programs.
• Familiarity with AML, transaction monitoring, or financial crime controls.
• Experience with machine learning models or predictive analytics.
• Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, or BigQuery.
