title: Senior Product Manager - Credit Risk
description:
About Bureau
Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
Why Bureau?
Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
About the Role: Senior Product Manager - Credit Risk
You'll own Bureau's credit product line: the signals, scores and decisioning tools lenders use to approve, price and monitor borrowers.
This is a builder's seat. You've shipped credit products from the lender's side; now you'll turn that judgment into products hundreds of lenders use.
What you ship will shape how millions of people in India and beyond get access to credit.
What you’ll be doing
• Own the credit signals roadmap. Pick the next signals to build, from alternative data and behavioural patterns to fraud indicators that predict credit risk.
• Go deep with lenders. Learn how banks, NBFCs and fintechs underwrite and collect, and turn their pain into product.
• Build across the credit lifecycle. Onboarding, underwriting, limits, early warnings and collections.
• Partner with data science. Define what a great signal looks like and take models from experiment to production.
• Ship, scale and prove impact. Launch API-first products and track approval rates, delinquency and fraud loss.
• Win with GTM and compliance. Help sales pitch and price credit deals, and keep products aligned with RBI and data protection rules.
What You’ll Bring
Must have
• 5–8 years in product, at PM or Senior PM level, owning products end to end.
• Consumer-side credit experience at a lender, NBFC, credit fintech or BNPL player, building and scaling products in India or globally.
• Hands-on with signals: bureau data, alternative data, risk scores or fraud indicators used to make better decisions.
• Data fluency. You can question a Gini or KS number and pull your own insights with SQL.
• Clear communication with a CRO, an engineer and a salesperson alike.
Good to have
• You've built or productised a credit score, risk model or decisioning engine.
• You've worked with India's credit stack: bureaus, Account Aggregator, UPI or GST data.
• You've sold data or risk tools to lenders on the B2B side.
Our Culture
• We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
• We value performance, not hours worked
• Speed, ownership, and impact matter most
Compensation
• Competitive salary + potential equity
• Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

Staff Engineer — Ad Monetization Architecture, Glance
We're building the ad monetization platform behind Glance - the lock screen and mobile surfaces that 100M+ people across India, Southeast Asia, Japan, Brazil and the US see every day , roughly half of them actively engaging. Every ad request carries real money , a real user's screen and an OEM partner's trust, and is decided in milliseconds on a low-end Android phone.
We're starting a focused new team of senior engineers in Bangalore. As its Staff Engineer (individual contributor , tech-lead track), you'll set the architecture, hold the quality bar , and be the person the team turns to when a design decision could move revenue.
What you will do
Own the architecture of the money path
• Design a demand-source-agnostic serving layer: any exchange, ad server or deal plugs in behind one contract we own (OpenRTB 2.6 with Glance extensions).
• Keep decisioning — auction, floors, priority and ad-load policy — in our platform, never in adapters or partner consoles.
• Define the rendering contract the client SDK depends on (native, V AST , MRAID/HTML).
• Make the big calls and write them down: ADRs, latency budgets, build-versus-use decisions with InMobi platform teams.
Serve ads inside the Glance experience
• Build ad slots into Glance's content feed, with ad load balanced against dismiss rate, session depth and retention.
• Design for prefetch: ads fetched ahead of time and shown later , sometimes offline - caching, expiry , pacing and delayed impression beacons all have to hold.
• Own per-user frequency and ad load across every demand source, within latency, battery and memory budgets on low-end Android.
Set the bar and grow the team
• Run design reviews across serving, SDK, automation and revenue data, and own the API contracts between them.
• Make "what proves this?" the first question on any pricing or serving change, AI-assisted code included: replay evals, invariant checks, auto-rollback canaries.
• Be accountable for integrity gates: creative safety , invalid traffic, policy compliance.
• Review revenue-event and partner-reconciliation design so the numbers hold up to OEM audit.
• Mentor senior engineers into area leads, and make sure every service has a second owner
What we expect
• 10+ years, including ownership of a low-latency , high-throughput system where a bad deploy shows up as lost revenue - ad serving, payments, trading or pricing.
• Distributed systems depth: partitioning, replication, consistency , failure modes, graceful degradation.
• Deep, hands-on Java and Spring Boot (our serving stack), including JVM/GC tuning for low latency; comfortable in Python (F astAPI) for ML and data services.
• Cloud (GCP or A WS), Kubernetes and CI/CD , designing for cost of serving, not just uptime
• Event pipelines at scale (Kafka, Spark or Flink), reconciled against an external source of truth
• Safe releases without a manual pass: contract and replay testing, canaries, automated rollback, SL Os you've been paged on RFCs and ADRs that lead to decisions, and influence across teams you don't manage
If you match most of this but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.
Nice to have
• Sell-side ad tech: SSPs, ad servers, Prebid / Prebid Server , Google Ad Manager.
• OpenRTB, V AST , MRAID and OM SDK; privacy signals (T CF , GPP) and supply-chain transparency (schain, sellers.json, app-ads. txt)
• Android or mobile SDK work under size, battery and cold-start budgets
• Consent frameworks (DPDP , GDPR, L GPD), invalid-traffic defences, or partner-billing systems that external partners audit
Why join us
• Shape it from day one: set the architecture and standards of a new team, not maintain someone else's
• Room to grow: become the org's architecture authority as the team scales, or move into engineering management
Since 2019, Glance has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.
This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
About POS :
Razorpay POS, Razorpay’s comprehensive suite of point-of-sale-led payment solutions, enables businesses to accept various modes of payment across all customer touchpoints. Be it across the counter, on delivery, or via kiosks and vending machines, Razorpay POS devices offer a smooth payment experience with fast processing and high transaction success rates. Merchants are also able to offer consumers convenient payment options like EMI right on the POS device. Access to real-time transaction data and analytics via the merchant portal enables businesses to drive data-led decisions.
With over 500,000+ user touchpoints across India & the UAE, Razorpay POS is at the forefront of transforming payment experiences.
Formerly known as Ezetap, Razorpay POS emerged after Ezetap’s acquisition by Razorpay in August 2022. As a full-stack financial services organization founded in 2014 by Shashank Kumar and Harshil Mathur, Razorpay is dedicated to innovative payment and business banking solutions, promising a transformative journey for businesses.
Role Summary:
We are seeking an experienced and driven professional to lead the Bank Retail vertical for POS sales. This role requires a combination of strategic planning, people management, and execution excellence. You will lead a team of individual contributors and be responsible for regional merchant acquisition, EMI/POS deployment, and building strategic relationships with banking partners.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Team Management & Leadership
• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of POS sales executives across assigned territories.
• Manage 4-6 Territory Managers directly
• Track team performance and ensure achievement of collective and individual targets.
• Drive a high-performance culture through regular reviews, feedback, and coaching.
2. Merchant Acquisition & Onboarding
• Oversee merchant onboarding across the region by supporting your team in identifying and converting leads.
• Build and maintain partnerships with banking institutions to drive joint acquisition efforts.
3. Sales Strategy & Execution
• Develop and implement regional POS sales strategies to drive revenue and market penetration.
• Collaborate with product and central teams to drive offers, campaigns, and merchant engagement plans.
• Monitor POS terminal sales and usage across geographies to identify growth and improvement areas.
4. Relationship Management
• Foster strong relationships with senior stakeholders at partner banks, NBFCs, and large retail merchants.
• Ensure effective resolution of merchant or partner issues raised through your team or partners.
5. Operational Oversight
• Ensure efficient deployment, activation, and usage of POS terminals managed by the team.
• Track and improve transaction volumes, first-month activation, and overall usage health.
6. Training & Enablement
• Oversee training programs for both bank staff and field teams to ensure proper understanding of POS products.
• Act as a knowledge resource for team members and bank partners, aligning them with business goals.
7. Market Intelligence & Reporting
• Analyze team reports and market data to understand trends, competition, and customer behavior.
• Share insights with internal stakeholders to fine-tune business strategies and product offerings.
• AI proficiency
• AI and digital competency- Demonstrated ability to use AI and data-led market intelligence tools to size state-level opportunities, build prospect lists, sharpen territory coverage and shorten deal closure cycle.s
• Coach team members to adopt these same practices.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
• Minimum 8-12 years of experience in POS, fintech, or banking domain, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
• Proven track record of managing high-performing sales teams and achieving business targets.
• Strong understanding of digital payments, retail merchant behavior, and POS lifecycle.
• Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
• Strategic thinker with a hands-on execution mindset.
• Comfortable with data analysis, reporting, and CRM systems.

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Product Security
description:
About Druva
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
Experience Level: 6–10 Years
Domain: Product Security / AppSec / DevSecOps / AI Security / AI-First SDLC
Role Summary
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Staff Product Security Engineer to join and lead initiatives across our product security landscape. In this role, you will redefine modern Product Security by architecting an AI-first SDLC seamlessly integrating traditional AppSec with advanced AI security practices, automating shift-left pipelines, conducting rigorous threat models for core services and complex AI architectures, and leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate vulnerability remediation. You will partner directly with engineering leadership, Information Security, GRC, BuildOps, and DevOps teams to secure our SaaS products and safely enable cutting-edge agentic features.
Role & Responsibilities
• AI-First SDLC & Shift-Left Automation: Architect and embed AI-driven security controls (SAST, DAST, SCA, Container, Secrets Detection) directly into CI/CD build pipelines and developer workflows, establishing an intelligent, highly automated AI-first SDLC.
• Operational & Strategic AI Security: Leverage AI tooling operationally (e.g., auto-triage, threat-model drafting, fix generation) while strategizing security controls for product-facing AI features.
• AI & Emerging Tech Threat Modeling: Assess risks specific to Generative and Agentic AI architectures, including MCP integrations, autonomous agents, tool-calling interfaces, multi-agent communication, prompt injections, and memory/context poisoning (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / Agentic Apps).
• Developer Guidance & Vulnerability Remediation: Review code (Python, Go, Javascript, etc), triage findings, and partner with engineering to implement robust short and long-term security fixes.
• Supply Chain & Software Integrity: Manage third-party open-source risks, open-source dependency tracking, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), and secure MCP/agent server ecosystems.
• Enablement & Champions Program: Conduct secure coding workshops, train developers on secure AI usage, and help grow an active Security Champions network.
Skills & Qualifications
• Experience: 6–10 years of product security engineering experience in a SaaS environment, with a proven track record of technical leadership.
• AppSec Fundamentals: Deep expertise in OWASP Top 10, CWE 25, threat modeling, cryptography, container security, and secure SDLC frameworks (SAMM, Microsoft SDL).
• AI Security & AI-First SDLC Expertise: Strong hands-on expertise with AI-first SDLC methodologies and reviewing AI security risks specifically around Agentic AI systems, MCP security (authorization, tool poisoning, confused deputy risks), and LLM security controls.
• Operational AI Use-Cases: Experience using AI tools to optimize security engineering workflows (e.g., automating root-cause analysis, threat modeling assistance, automated policy generation).
• Programming & Tooling: Proficient in code review and scripting with Python, Go, or Javascript (hands-on development experience is a major plus). Hands-on with tools like Burp Suite, Snyk, OWASP ZAP, and CI/CD security scanners.
• Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in CS/IT or equivalent. Relevant certifications (OSCP, OSWE, CSSLP, GIAC) or active community contributions (OWASP, BSides, NullCon, Black Hat, etc) are a plus.

title: Associate Lead Data Scientist (RGM)
description:

You’ll work with teams that push the boundaries of what-is-possible and build solutions that energize and inspire.
Offices: New York | Dallas | San Francisco | Lima | Bengaluru

About the Role:

If you are passionate to work on complex unstructured business problems that can be solved using data science and machine learning, we would like to talk to you.
Role: ALDS (RGM)

• Strong ability to work with large-scale sales, shopper, and syndicated data (e.g., Nielsen, IRI, POS, retailer data) to drive actionable insights

• Experience leading cross-functional data science projects and mentoring junior team members

• Good understanding in statistics, and ability to design statistical hypothesis testing to aid formal decision making.

• Engaging with clients, understanding complex problem statements, and offering solutions in the domains of Retail, Pharma, Banking, Insurance, etc.

• Develop data science roadmap, and guide data scientist to meet their deliverables.
• Handling end-to-end client AI & analytics programs. Your role will be a combination of hands-on contribution, technical team management, and client interaction.
• Proven ability to discover solutions hidden in large datasets and to drive business results with their data-based insights
• Drive excellent project management required to deliver complex projects, including effort/time estimation.
• Be proactive, with full ownership of the engagement. Build scalable client engagement level processes for faster turnaround & higher accuracy
• Define Technology/ Strategy and Roadmap for client accounts, and guides implementation of that strategy within projects
• Run regular project reviews and audits to ensure that projects are being executed within the guardrails agreed by all stakeholders
• Manage the team-members, to ensure that the project plan is being adhered to over the course of the project
• Manage the client stakeholders, and their expectations, with a regular cadence of weekly meetings and status updates.
• Build a trusted advisor relationship with the IT management at clients and internal accounts leadership.
• Build business case for technological investments to be made for future needs and to remain competitive
• Ensure that billing and utilization of team members is maximized throughout the year
Desired Skills:
• Experience designing data science solutions to business problems
• Deep understanding of ML algorithms for common use cases in both structured and unstructured data ecosystems.
• Comfortable with large scale data processing and distributed computing
• Allocates workload among team members and by taking into consideration employee availability, skill set, and current workload when making assignments.
• Providing required inputs to sales, and pre-sales activities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Desired Experience & Education:
• 4- 6 years of relevant Machine Learning experience.
• Minimum Master’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Computational Statistics, Operations Research, Machine Learning or related technical fields.

title: Senior Manager - Support Operations
description:

HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 800+ leading companies worldwide.Trusted by prestigious organizations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimizes order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for three consecutive years.

Job Summary:

This team is responsible for providing high-quality support for our robust and scalable SaaS products. As a Support Manager, you will be a key leader, ensuring our team delivers continuous, delightful customer experiences and resolves issues efficiently.

What You’ll Get

• Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)

• Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
About the role
HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.
In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. You'll shape how the platform evolves across richer ADE experiences (harnesses like Claude Code and Codex CLI), Chakra Assist for evaluation, richer session observation (screen sharing, A/V), and reporting across in-product, exports, APIs and MCP. You'll work closely with engineers as collaborators and as the product's core customer and user base including senior engineering leadership as stakeholders who care deeply about this space.
What you will do
• Own the roadmap for how HackerRank Interviews evaluates AI-assisted development including richer ADE harnesses, Chakra Assist, and session observation capabilities.
• Define how the platform captures and surfaces signals on how candidates prompt, review and apply AI-generated work, so interviewers get clearer, structured evidence.
• Drive the reporting and integration strategy across in-product reporting, exports, APIs and MCP.
• Engage directly with engineering customers and users including senior engineering leadership as the primary audience for this product, translating their needs into roadmap decisions.
• Represent the product in high-visibility, customer-facing moments with composure, including when executives engage directly and unexpectedly.
• Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship production-quality, AI-native interview experiences.
• Embrace AI - in how we operate, as well as in the product.
Who you are
• Overall 7+ years of total professional experience including at least 1 year of hands-on Software Engineering.
• 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably building B2B SaaS, enterprise products and/or tech services and/or platforms, and you are currently working as a PM today.
• Comfortable being the technical/product voice in a room full of engineers, including stakeholders like senior engineering leadership
• Able to stay composed and sound under sudden high-visibility pressure for example, a CTO persona dropping into a live customer channel.
• A strategic thinker who can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and balance short-term progress with long-term success.
• Deeply passionate about AI using it as a reflex across your own workflows, not just in the product you build.
• Ability to deep dive into ambitious problem statements and create customer value.
• Proven track record of successfully launching and growing new products and/or significant features.
• Ability to work in a fast paced cross team, cross geo environment and to deliver on a common vision.
• Ability to work with engineers, designers and analysts and be comfortable presenting to non-technical/business stakeholders and customers.
Even better if you have
• Hands-on fluency with agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or similar) deep enough to reason about what a good AI-assisted engineering actually looks like.
• Experience designing or owning a GTM motion where the buyer and user were engineers or engineering leadership, rather than a traditional non-technical economic buyer.
• Experience operating in a lean, founder-style team with no dedicated marketing support i.e., you've personally built your own sales decks, messaging and customer-facing materials before, not just briefed a marketing team.
• Background in HR tech, talent assessment, or technical hiring.
• Experience building reporting/analytics or API-level integrations (e.g. MCP, data exports) for a technical audience.
You will thrive in this role if you
• You are a builder at heart. You enjoy creating something from scratch, transforming ideas into tangible, high-impact products.
• Ambiguity excites you. You’re comfortable working in undefined spaces, carving out clarity where little exists, and defining a clear vision and strategy.
• You take a customer-first approach. You excel at identifying unmet customer needs and turning those insights into innovative product solutions.
• You are a strategic thinker. You can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and make decisions that balance short-term progress with long-term success.
• You thrive in fast-paced environments. You’re energised by working on high-impact initiatives where priorities can shift as you gain new insights.
• You have a bias for action. You’re not afraid to experiment, iterate, and learn quickly in pursuit of delivering exceptional outcomes.
• You are deeply passionate about AI. You’re in the weeds and trying out AI tools constantly and are at a point where you are using AI as a reflex to try and automate several workflows in your life and 10x yourself.
